v: I cried to you, LORD. I said, “You are my refuge, my portion in the land of the living.”
b: In this passage the psalmist David tells us that he cried out to God and asked Him for help, and declared that God is his refuge and his portion. This passage reminds us that God is not only our protector, but also our portion.

The nation of Israel went through war, hardship, and trials many times. In these dangers they learned to depend on God and seek His help. Like the psalmist David, they were convinced that God was their refuge and their portion. They believed that only under God’s shelter could they truly feel the meaning of life and God’s blessing.

This passage also echoes our daily lives. In each of our lives we will meet all kinds of challenges and difficulties. Sometimes we may feel lonely, confused, or disappointed. But whatever we face, we can entrust ourselves to God, because He is our refuge and our portion. A child named Annie was bullied and laughed at by her classmates at school. Every day when she came home she felt discouraged and sad. One day, when she needed it most, she went to talk with her grandmother.

Her grandmother told her softly, “Annie, don’t forget that God is your refuge, and He will protect you. There you will find true blessing.” When Annie heard her grandmother’s words, confidence and courage suddenly welled up in her heart. She began to ask God for help, and she found that she really felt His shelter and blessing. This enabled her to endure the difficulties at school and become a strong child.

This story reminds us that when we face adversity, God is our refuge and our portion. When we learn to entrust ourselves to Him and trust His protection and blessing, we can find strength and peace in hardship.

So let us remember every day that however great the difficulties we face, God is always our refuge and our portion. Let us trust Him, seek His help, and believe that He will bring faith into our lives.
ah: As Christians, we know that God is our refuge and also our portion. In daily life, we can put this truth into practice in the following ways:
a: Pray at set times every day
Seek God’s help and protection, and recognize Him as our refuge.
Read and meditate
Keep this passage in your heart and remind yourself to cry out humbly before God.
Share testimonies of faith
Share with brothers and sisters what God has done in your life, encouraging and building one another up.
Help those in need
With God as our portion, look for opportunities to help others and show God’s love.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for being our refuge and our portion. Help us live out this faith in daily life, to look to You in difficulty and to praise You in abundance. Lead us to be a help and a witness to one another, and to grow in faith by encouraging one another. We pray in the name of Jesus. Amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you: when you face difficulty, may you remember that God is your refuge and your portion. May you entrust yourself to Him every day and trust His protection and blessing. Because of faith, hope, and love, may you be full of strength and peace. Amen.

v: Whoever causes the upright to go astray in an evil way, he will fall into his own trap; but the blameless will inherit good.
b: This passage reminds us that in this world temptation and desire are everywhere. We often face all kinds of choices, and some choices may lure us onto an evil path, but we must stay upright.

The Bible has a story about Joseph and his brothers. Joseph was Jacob’s son and his father’s favorite child. His brothers were jealous of him and planned to kill him. But in the end they decided to sell him to Egyptian traders. In Egypt, Joseph went through many hardships and trials, including being falsely accused and thrown into prison. Yet he always held to his integrity and, unmoved by temptation, did not choose evil. In the end God blessed Joseph, and he became prime minister of Egypt and inherited abundant blessing.

This story tells us that even in the face of temptation, we should choose to stay upright. God has abundant blessing prepared for those who hold to their integrity. Sometimes temptation may look very attractive, but remember that paying the price will certainly end badly.

In our lives there are all kinds of temptation too. It may be the temptation to sin, to deceive, or to give up our faith. Whatever temptation we face, let us keep this proverb in mind: “Whoever causes the upright to go astray in an evil way, he will fall into his own pit, but the blameless will inherit good.” Only those who hold to their integrity and resist temptation can enjoy the abundant blessing God gives.
dc:
In the name of the Lord, I bless you: may you stay upright when you face temptation and inherit the blessing God has prepared. Amen.
No. 452 Soul Snack Action Guide. Proverbs 28:10: Whoever causes the upright to go astray in an evil way, he will fall into his own pit, but the blameless will inherit good.

v: “But go your way until the end; for you will rest, and will stand in your inheritance at the end of the days.”
b: This passage gives us an important message: we should hold to our faith and wait patiently for God’s time. Sometimes we may feel confused and uneasy, not knowing what our future will be. Yet this passage reminds us that we need to believe God is in control of everything, and He knows the timing that is best for us.

Like a farmer waiting for the crops he planted to ripen, we also need to wait patiently for the blessing God has prepared for us. When the crops finally ripen, the farmer can not only enjoy the fruit of the harvest, but also taste the sweetness of his hard work. In the same way, when we hold on to faith while waiting, God will give us abundant blessing at the most fitting time.

Sometimes in life we meet setbacks and difficulties, such as pressure at work, conflict in the family, health problems, and so on. These troubles may leave us feeling discouraged and helpless, but when we wait for the end with firm faith, we will experience a wonderful change. Just as a butterfly takes wing after its transformation, we too can find strength in hardship, stand up again, and enjoy the blessing God gives.

So, dear family, whatever your present situation, I encourage you to keep faith and wait patiently for God’s plan to be carried out. Believe He will bless you at the right time. Just as dawn always follows the night, let us believe that the light is about to come.
dc:
In the name of the Lord, I bless you: may you find peace and hope in waiting. May you feel God’s love and abundance in the moment of enjoying your blessing. Amen.
No. 453 Soul Snack Action Guide. Daniel 12:13: “But go your way until the end; for you will rest, and will stand in your inheritance at the end of the days.”

v: but one thing is needed. Mary has chosen the good part, which will not be taken away from her.”
b: This passage tells us the story of Mary and her sister Martha. When Jesus visited their home, Mary chose to sit at Jesus’ feet and listen to His words, while Martha was busy serving the guests and felt it was unfair. Jesus said to Martha not to trouble herself with so many things, because Mary had chosen the good portion.

This story reminds us of important values in life. Sometimes we may fall into a life of busyness and anxiety, and in pursuing material success or other worldly goals we overlook what matters most. We may chase money, position, or social status, but these are temporary and cannot bring true satisfaction and peace.

But Mary chose to listen to Jesus’ words and spent her time in communion with God and learning. She understood that in a busy world, spiritual growth and connection with God are most important. She chose the good portion, a blessing that cannot be taken away.

This story reminds us that in our daily lives we should strive to seek closeness to God and spiritual growth. Do not let work, study, or other affairs fill our lives and crowd out communion with God and learning. This requires us to actively find quiet moments and to cultivate spiritual habits such as prayer, Bible reading, and taking part in the life of the church community.

When we choose such a blessing, we will find God’s grace and blessing filling our lives. We will have inner peace and joy, even when our surroundings or difficulties keep changing. This good portion is one each of us can have, and it is eternal and cannot be taken away.

So let us choose the good portion like Mary, and strive to pursue closeness to God and spiritual growth. May we find quiet in busyness, seek peace in anxiety, and experience in life the grace and blessing of God that cannot be taken away.
a: Focus on what is important
In daily life, learn to tell what is important from what is not, and focus on the things that are truly meaningful and bring blessing.
Choose the good portion
Like Mary, make wise choices, choosing the things that accord with God’s heart and bring blessing and joy.
Hold firmly to your choice
Once you have made the good choice, hold to it steadfastly and do not be affected by outside distractions or temptations.
Keep gratitude and joy
While holding to the good portion, keep a thankful and joyful heart at all times and face every challenge with thanksgiving.
Share the blessing
Share the blessing you have received with others, letting God’s love and grace flow out through your life and become a blessing to others.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for giving us the way of the good portion in our lives. We ask You to help us focus on what is important, choose the good portion, hold firmly to our choice, keep a thankful and joyful heart, and be willing to share the blessing we have received with others. May our lives be a witness to God, bringing blessing and hope to those around us. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus. Amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you: may you choose the good portion in your daily life, draw near to God, and experience His peace and joy. Amen.

v: If you will not listen, and if you will not take it to heart, to give glory to my name,” says the LORD of Armies, “then I will send the curse on you, and I will curse your blessings. Indeed, I have cursed them already, because you do not take it to heart.
b: This passage reminds us that when we give glory to God and keep His way, He will bless us greatly. But if we do not listen to His word and do not honor His name, He may send a curse upon us and turn the blessing that was ours into a curse.
A farmer proudly showed off his crops in harvest season, saying confidently, “Look, these are all the fruit of my effort!”

But this farmer did not give all the glory to God. He took pride in his own wisdom and diligence and forgot that everything came from God’s compassion and grace. Suddenly a great wind blew down all his crops, and his blessing turned into a disaster.

This story tells us that when we receive blessing, we should not forget to give the glory to God. We should humbly acknowledge His grace and attribute everything to His work. Then our blessing can remain stable and not turn into a curse.

In our daily lives we can also learn how to give glory to God. When we achieve success, let us humbly thank God for His guidance and help. When we face difficulty and challenge, let us trust God’s promise, knowing that He will surely lead us out of the trouble.
So let us not forget to give glory to God, to worship Him humbly, and to rely on His grace. Only then can our blessing remain stable and bring true blessing.
a: Listen to God’s word
Meditate on the Bible every day, take God’s word to heart, and follow its teaching.
Give glory to God
Seek God’s kingdom and righteousness in everything, and not rely on your own strength.
Learn obedience and humility
Willingly submit to God’s will, lay down pride, and seek God’s guidance and grace.
Fear the name of God
Walk with God with a heart of reverence, keep His commandments, and live out respect for God.
pr: Heavenly Father, thank You for Your word and teaching. Help us in daily life to keep a heart of obedience and humility, to fear Your name, and to give glory to Your name. Give us wisdom and firm faith, so that our blessing may always remain in Your blessing. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus. Amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you: may you give glory to God in everything and enjoy the abundant blessing He brings you. Amen.

v: He couched, he lay down as a lion, as a lioness; who shall rouse him up? Everyone who blesses you is blessed. Everyone who curses you is cursed.”
b: This passage tells us that when we stand on God’s side, we are blessed. Like the lion and the lioness, we have great power and authority and are able to face the challenges and difficulties of life. Who dares to rouse us? God’s power is with us.

In our lives, someone may bless us, and this is God’s grace inclining toward us. These blessings not only bring us joy and happiness, but even more, they can become a source of motivation and confidence for us to move forward. Let us receive these blessings with grateful hearts and share this blessing with the people around us.

Yet someone may want to curse us or hold hostility toward us. But God’s word tells us that these curses will not take effect, because we stand on God’s side. We can lay down fear and worry, because we know that God is the Lord who rules over everything. His love and protection will keep us from any harm.

There was once a little girl who lived in a dangerous neighborhood where crime often happened. On her way to school every day she was always frightened, afraid of being hurt. But she was a believer, and she trusted that God’s protection was with her.

One day, as she was walking home, a strange man suddenly approached her and tried to snatch her backpack. The man looked very strong and fierce, but the little girl was not afraid. She immediately called out the name of God and believed that God would protect her.

At that moment a big dog ran up from the street corner, barking fiercely. The man was frightened and ran away at once. The little girl thanked God, because she knew that the dog was a messenger God had sent to protect her.

This story tells us that when we stand on God’s side, we have supernatural protection and strength. Whatever difficulty and challenge we face, before God everything yields to His power. God’s blessing is so powerful that, whether it comes from others’ kind blessing or from God’s own wonderful intervention, we can receive peace and strength.

So, dear family, let us remember the truth of this passage every day. Whether we are being blessed, or facing a curse and hardship, let us keep in mind God’s promise and protection. As long as we trust in God firmly, He will surely lead us to light and victory.
ah: To put being blessed into practice in daily life, we must first keep in mind God’s promise to us: “Blessed be everyone who blesses you. Cursed be everyone who curses you.”
a: Live in peace with others

The picture of the lion crouching and the lioness lying down illustrates that in dealing with people we should show a balance of strength and gentleness. Do not be easily provoked, and seek reconciliation with others.
Actively bless others
Take the initiative to express blessing to others, whether verbal blessing or practical help and support. By blessing others, we too will be blessed.
Hold forgiveness and love in your heart

When others curse or offend us, learn to forgive and respond with love. Such conduct builds an environment of peace and blessing. May we practice these action guides every day and show God’s love and grace in life. Let us spread blessing and be blessed, with the courage of the great lion and the soft heart of the lioness. Amen.
pr: Heavenly Father, thank You for giving us this precious passage, which reminds us to show Your spirit in daily life as a lion that crouches and a lioness that lies down. Help us live in peace with others, actively bless others, and always hold forgiveness and love in our hearts. Give us strength and wisdom, so that we become channels of blessing and are blessed in You. Amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you: may you continually receive God’s blessing and protection on the journey of life. May your path be full of faith and hope, because God walks with you. May your life be a witness that shows God’s glory and love. Amen.

v: You will be blessed above all peoples. There won’t be male or female barren among you, or among your livestock.
b: This passage tells us that as the people of God, we are blessed. God gives us boundless grace so that we can surpass other peoples. Not only that, we are also given the ability to multiply, so that humans and animals alike are blessed and full of the abundance of life.

A farmer planted a field of wheat, hoping for a rich harvest. He worked hard to cultivate the land, irrigate it, and pull the weeds. He threw himself wholeheartedly into the work, believing that God would bless his hard labor. In the end his field bore abundant fruit, and he was blessed by God.

In the same way, when we serve God wholeheartedly and water the soil of our lives with faith, hope, and love, we too will be blessed like that farmer. God will give us spiritual and material abundance, and our lives will be full of His grace and blessing.

Yet this does not mean we will not meet difficulty or adversity. There will always be challenges and tests in life, but it is in these times that we can experience God’s power and miracles more deeply. Just as Noah received God’s protection and rescue in the great flood, when we trust God’s promise and hold to our faith, we will also be led out of difficulty and gain His victory.

So when we face difficulty, let us not lose hope and faith. God says to us, “You shall be blessed above all peoples.” This is His promise to us. Believe His word, use our abilities, and bring God’s love and the gospel to the world.
ah: “Dear family, peace to you. Let us follow together the action guide of today’s Soul Snack:
a: Ask the Lord to give the grace of children: in daily life we should often seek God’s grace in prayer, that our men and women may be blessed to bear children, and build a good family for the Lord.
Treasure family and fellowship: create an atmosphere of harmony and warmth at home, treat one another with love, and grow together in the church fellowship, encouraging and supporting one another.

Be honest and kind in dealing with others: in the workplace and in social settings, show honesty and integrity, treat others with love, forgiveness, and tolerance as the standard, and build harmonious relationships.
Care for and serve others: take the initiative to care about others’ needs, be willing to reach out a hand to brothers and sisters who need help, and show the love and compassion of Christ.
Hold to holiness and fear God: keep holy in everything, and fear God in thought, word, and deed, so that we become a witness who is blessed before both God and people.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for giving us abundant promises, so that in daily life we can be Your witnesses, blessed above all peoples. Give us wisdom and strength to help us show Your love and grace in our actions. We pray in the name of Jesus Christ. Amen.”
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you: may you experience God’s abundance and blessing every day. Amen.

v: the blessing, if you listen to the commandments of the LORD your God, which I command you today;
b: On the journey of life we often pursue the path of blessing, hoping to find spiritual and material peace and joy. Yet this passage reminds us that true blessing comes not merely from the worldly wealth we pursue, but even more from keeping God’s commandments and walking in His way.

When we submit to God’s will and keep His commandments, we are like a great tree rooted beside a stream. We enjoy the nourishment of the source of life, our leaves are lush, and we bear abundant fruit. Our lives will be full of God’s grace and strength and will become a blessing and comfort to those around us. A young man named Ruiming often met challenges and difficulties at work. But he believed firmly in the promise in this passage and relied on God from the bottom of his heart. Facing a critical decision, Ruiming chose to keep God’s commandments, and even though everyone around him objected, he held to his conviction.

As a result, God showed Ruiming His great power and wisdom, and opened a way out for him in his most difficult moment. Ruiming’s faithfulness and obedience brought unexpected benefit and blessing, not only at work but in every area of life. His life became a witness to those around him and showed God’s glory. So let us pursue keeping God’s commandments every day and believe His promise, and we shall be blessed. Whatever challenge or hardship we face, God’s grace and strength are sufficient to guide us through everything.
a: Learn to listen to God’s word
Spend time every day reading the Bible and thinking about how God’s word applies to life.
Keep God’s commandments
Put the truth you have learned into practice, for example loving your neighbor as yourself and acting justly.
Ask for the Holy Spirit’s help
Pray for the Holy Spirit’s guidance and strength to help us hold to God’s commandments.
Share with other believers
Share with other brothers and sisters how you put God’s word into practice in daily life, encouraging one another and growing together.
pr: Heavenly Father, thank You for giving us Your word and commandments. Help us in daily life to learn to listen to Your word, keep Your commandments, and rely on the Holy Spirit’s guidance and help. May we share our faith and growth with brothers and sisters and walk together in Your way. We pray in the name of Jesus Christ. Amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you: may you keep God’s commandments, receive His blessing and grace, and experience His kindness every day of your life. Amen!

v: You shall be blessed in the fruit of your body, the fruit of your ground, the fruit of your animals, the increase of your livestock, and the young of your flock.
b: In this passage God promises us that His blessing will come upon everything we have: from our children and our crops to our livestock, and all our wealth and resources. This is a beautiful promise that shows us God’s care and provision for us.

As this passage reveals, when we are faithful to God and submit to His will, we will be blessed. This blessing is not limited to material abundance, but includes peace of heart, joy, and satisfaction. When we seek to submit to God’s will and keep His commands, we will receive abundant favor and blessing. Just as the ground yields rich fruit, when we sow love, kindness, and upright conduct, we too will reap good results. A sister named Liping, when she met challenges at work, always trusted the Lord and shared her faith and kindness in the office every day. Though her surroundings might be full of pressure and competition, she always kept joy and peace. In the end she was promoted and given a leadership position, which was entirely God’s blessing and grace.
So let us keep in mind how to apply this passage in daily life: whatever difficulty or challenge we face, as long as we believe in and rely on God, His blessing will be our strength and protection.
ah: “Dear family, peace to you. Let us follow together the action guide of today’s Soul Snack.” According to Deuteronomy 28:4, this passage mentions God’s promise, which shows that all that is born of the body, produced by the ground, and born of the livestock will be blessed. This tells us that God’s provision for us is all-round, not limited to our needs, but including our family and everything around us. So in daily life we can practice the following ways to experience God’s blessing:
a: Thanksgiving and praise
Starting each morning, face the challenges of each day with a thankful heart and praise God’s grace and provision.
Share and be generous
While we are blessed, remember to share with others and support brothers and sisters in need with a generous heart.
Be kind to animals and nature
Take good care of the livestock and nature around us, with reverence and care in the way we treat all things.
Honesty and integrity
Stay honest and upright in work and life, act with care, and show sincerity to God and people.
Sow seeds of hope
Face any difficulty with hope and love, share God’s hope with others, and be a witness of God’s love.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for being present everywhere in our lives and for promising us blessing. Help us put the promise into practice in daily life and live each day with an attitude of gratitude, generosity, devotion, and hope. May Your grace always be with us, and make us witnesses of Your glory. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus. Amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you: may you walk in God’s grace and blessing. Amen!

v: You shall be blessed when you come in, and you shall be blessed when you go out.
b: This passage tells us that whether we are going out or coming in, we can be blessed. When we go out, we may face all kinds of challenges and difficulties, but God promises that even as we go out we can still be blessed. When we enter a new environment or face something new, we can also receive blessing from God.

There was an adventurer named Jordan who decided to explore an uncharted island. As he got ready to set out, his friends told him the adventure was dangerous, full of unknown risks and hardships. But Jordan said without flinching, “I trust God’s promise: I will be blessed in my going out and my coming in!”

When Jordan set foot on the island, he met many difficulties: thick jungle, steep mountains and dangerous animals. Yet he never gave up, because he knew God was with him. During that time he learned to rely on God’s strength, and he experienced many miracles and blessings.

In the end, Jordan explored the entire island and brought back precious treasure. The journey not only helped him grow and enriched his experience, but also made him more deeply convinced that the promise, “You shall be blessed when you come in, and you shall be blessed when you go out,” is true.

This story tells us that wherever we are, we can be blessed because of God’s grace. When we face difficulties, we can trust God’s guidance and protection; when we enter a new environment, we can believe that God will bless us there.
So let us live each day full of faith and hope, believing God’s promise, that whether we go out or come in, we can be blessed because of God’s love and grace.
ah: “Dear family, peace to you. Let us put into practice together today’s Soul Snack action guide.”
a: Thanksgiving and Praise
Each morning when you wake, first thank the Lord and praise Him for giving us a new day; at night before sleep, look back on the day’s graces and give thanks again, praising God’s lovingkindness.
Walking Together

In daily life, take the initiative to care for the brothers and sisters around you, sharing life, prayer and spiritual practice with them; support one another in hard times and laugh together in times of joy.
Seeking God’s Will
In everything, seek God’s will. At work, at home, at church or in social settings, take the teaching of Scripture as your guide, and let God’s word direct our steps.
Faithful Service

Each week find one opportunity to serve, quietly giving of yourself for others and showing the love of Christ. Whether at church, in the community or at home, serve others wholeheartedly and express God’s lovingkindness.
Pray Without Ceasing

Keep communicating with the Lord, feed on God’s word, and pray often. Whether in morning and evening prayer, silent prayer in your heart, or calling on God’s name at any moment, let prayer be the channel that draws us close to the Lord. “Let us pray together.” Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for giving us this good time today. Help us put Your word into practice in daily life, and let Your glory be shown through our actions. Help us walk with the Lord, love one another, seek Your will at all times, serve others wholeheartedly, and keep communing with You in prayer. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus, amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you be blessed in your going out and your coming in, and may you enjoy God’s blessing and grace. Amen.

v: God said to Balaam, “You shall not go with them. You shall not curse the people, for they are blessed.”
b: In this passage we see God forbidding Balaam to curse the nation of Israel, because they are blessed. This makes us think: what does it mean to be blessed? How can we become blessed people?

Being blessed does not refer only to material abundance; it means receiving true happiness and fulfillment within God’s love and grace. God created us and has prepared a rich life for us. Yet true blessing lies not merely in material enjoyment, but in building an intimate relationship with God and obeying His will.

Just as Balaam was forbidden to curse Israel, we too must keep away from the path of turning from God, from words that slander others, and from an attitude of envy and greed. These behaviors only stand in the way of our becoming blessed people.

On the contrary, when we treat others with love, kindness and tolerance, we become channels of God’s blessing. Let us use love to build and mend relationships, supporting and encouraging one another, so that God’s glory is displayed.
In our daily lives, let us always remember God’s word: “The people are blessed.” Wherever we are and whatever challenges we meet, we are blessed.
a: Do Not Readily Criticize or Curse Others
Look at others with goodwill and tolerance, and do not casually criticize or belittle people.
Pass On Blessing and Positive Energy
Actively pass blessing and positive energy to others, so that the people around you feel God’s grace.
Learn Gratitude and Praise
Each day find a few reasons to give thanks, and express praise and gratitude, so that you and others can feel joy and contentment.
Hold Fast to Faith in Difficult Times
When facing difficulties and challenges, keep faith and hope, believing that God will lead us out of hardship.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for today’s revelation and guidance. Help us put Your word into practice in daily life, treat others with love and humility, and become a channel of blessing to others through Your grace. Give us strength and wisdom so that Your glory is shown in our lives. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus, amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you! May you experience God’s abundance and fulfillment every day. May you influence others with love and kindness and become a channel of blessing. Amen.

v: “Now therefore arise, LORD God, into your resting place, you, and the ark of your strength. Let your priests, LORD God, be clothed with salvation, and let your saints rejoice in goodness.
b: This passage reminds us that when we seek God’s presence, He will come to be with us in person, giving peace and rest. Just as the ark in Old Testament times represented God’s presence, today we too can invite God into our lives through prayer and worship.

Here “salvation” refers to God’s deliverance and protection, and “saints” refers to believers, that is, us. When we build an intimate relationship with God, His salvation and blessing come upon us. This is not only about material blessing, but even more about inner joy and peace.

Imagine a person facing all kinds of difficulties and challenges, feeling lost and helpless. He does not know how to solve his problems and feels isolated and abandoned. But when he begins to seek God’s presence, it is as if the ark of God has entered his life. The ark symbolizes God’s presence and power, and its presence brings him security and hope.

Having God’s presence does not mean we no longer face problems, but it gives us strength and wisdom to handle them. Just as the ark traveled with the Israelites, God’s presence will guide us onto the right path. When we meet setbacks and hardships, we can trust His leading and believe in His plan.

Besides God’s presence, we also have God’s priests clothed with salvation. This shows our identity as Christians and as God’s people: we have received God’s rescue and redemption. This identity gives us peace and joy and enables us to hold on to faith in adversity.
Let us walk with God and enjoy the blessings He gives. Whatever challenges we face, let us believe in God’s guidance and protection, for He is our strength and our hope.
ah: “Dear family, peace to you. Let us put into practice together today’s Soul Snack action guide.”
a: Ask God to Be with You
When you get up each morning, first pray and ask the Lord to be with us, and sense His presence and power.
Let the Holy Spirit Be Your Salvation
In daily life, always seek the Holy Spirit’s guidance and let Him lead us to follow God’s will.
Share Blessing and Joy
Share God’s blessing and joy through action; be kind to others so that they too can feel God’s love.
Take Part Actively in Church Life
Take an active part in church gatherings, service and fellowship, worshiping God and learning His word together with other believers, and growing together.
Pray Often to Bless Others

Pray often for the people around you, and ask for blessing on the church and the community, making yourself a channel of prayer that brings life transformation. “Let us pray together.” Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for today’s word reminding us to be with You and to practice our faith in daily life. Help us actively seek the Holy Spirit’s guidance and share one another’s joys and burdens, that we may be Your witnesses. Lord, help us become one body in church life, supporting one another and walking together on Your way. Thank You, LORD; may our lives be filled with Your blessing and joy. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus, amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you feel God’s presence and His grace every day. May you find peace and joy in difficulty, and walk with God in faith. Amen.

v: All day long he deals graciously, and lends. His offspring is blessed.
b: This passage speaks of a person who is kind to others and glad to lend to them, and whose descendants are blessed because of it. This tells us that our actions and choices affect not only ourselves, but also our children and grandchildren.

Imagine a farmer who has a piece of fertile land. He works diligently all day, growing all kinds of vegetables and fruit. He not only meets his own needs but is also willing to share his harvest with those in need. He donates part of his produce to poor families so that they have food to eat. He is also glad to lend seed and tools to other farmers, helping them start their own farming ventures.

This farmer’s kindness and generosity not only brought blessing to him, but continued to influence his descendants. His children inherited their father’s good character and attitude, and passed on this spirit of treating others well and helping gladly. They became philanthropists and volunteers in the community, constantly helping those in need, and continued to enjoy God’s blessing in their lives.

This story tells us that when we treat others with love and gladly share what we have, we not only create a beautiful chain reaction among people, but also sow seeds of blessing in our families. Our good deeds bring blessing to our descendants, filling their lives with faith, hope and love.

So let us follow this farmer’s example: each day do our best to be kind to others, be glad to lend, and carry this beautiful spirit on among our descendants. May we be a beacon showing God’s love to the world, blessed in our own lives and letting our descendants be blessed too.
ah: “Dear family, peace to you. Let us put into practice together today’s Soul Snack action guide:
a: Be Kind to Others
In daily life, we can learn to treat others with kindness and compassion, whether family, friends or strangers. Offer help, support and care without stinting, showing God’s love.
Lend to Others
Share your resources and time, and be willing to offer assistance to help those in need. This includes material and spiritual support, sharing the burdens of others together.
Descendants Also Blessed

Such love and good deeds bring not only present blessing but also influence on future generations. Our actions will become a bridge of blessing for our descendants, so that they too can enjoy God’s grace.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for giving us this wonderful passage, teaching us how to be kind to one another and help one another in daily life. Grant us power and wisdom to carry out the teaching of this passage, to be witnesses of Your love, and let our descendants also be blessed through our good deeds. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus, amen.”
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you find your own peace and joy in generosity and love. Amen.

v: His offspring will be mighty in the land. The generation of the upright will be blessed.
b: This verse tells us that when we live with uprightness and righteousness, our descendants will be blessed and made strong in this world. This is an encouraging message; let us see how it can be realized in our daily lives.

Imagine a farmer who works devoutly, planting crops for his family and community. He tills the soil, irrigates the crops, and puts his whole heart into it. Because of his effort and passion for his work, his crops grow strong and bring the joy of a bountiful harvest. But that is not the end: his children also go on enjoying this abundance. They learn from their father the importance of diligence and perseverance, and pass it on. They develop their own talents and skills and make important contributions to the community. One generation helps the next, forming a family that keeps growing and being blessed.

In the same way, in our spiritual lives we can see this kind of blessing for descendants. When we serve God with an upright and sincere heart, our faith influences our children and descendants. They see our steadfastness and love for God and follow in our footsteps. They also learn the values of honesty, kindness and serving others. In their lives these virtues will continue to flower and bear fruit, bringing blessing and strength.

So how can we put this truth into practice in daily life? First, we need to treat others, including family, friends and strangers, with uprightness and righteousness. In any circumstance we should show respect and care. Second, we need to show diligence and perseverance, whether at work or in study. Such an attitude will teach our descendants the value of hard work and striving. Finally, we should deal with people and matters with love and forgiveness. This will strengthen our family relationships and convey the values of harmony and peace.
So let us be that devout farmer, cultivating our lives and sowing the seeds of uprightness and righteousness.
a: Set an Example of Upright Living
Take uprightness as a principle, and show Christian integrity in your work, words and conduct, becoming a model for the next generation.
Persevere in Prayer
Pray often for your descendants, asking the Lord to keep them and guide them on the right path.
Teach and Nurture
Teach the next generation with the truth of Scripture, help them know God’s salvation, and cultivate their character.
Love and Support
Be there for your descendants with care and support, so that they feel love and warmth.
Humility and Patience

Treat your descendants with a humble heart, giving them room to grow, and face challenges with patience and tolerance. “Let us pray: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for this good time to think and learn together. Help us practice uprightness, love and hope in daily life, and be a blessing and example to our descendants. May You bless our efforts so that our lives show Your glory. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, amen.”
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you all! May your descendants be mighty in the land and receive God’s blessing. Whatever challenges you face in life, remember the truth of this verse and believe that the generation of the upright will surely be blessed. Amen.

t: Those Who Fear God Will Be Blessed
v: Behold, this is how the man who fears the LORD is blessed.
b: In this passage God shows us the importance of fearing Him and how we will be blessed because of it. Fearing God is not merely a dread that arises from reverent love for God; it is an attitude of complete trust and obedience. Like wise parents, we should honor God and believe His word and guidance.

There was a young man named Zhihan who held God in deep reverence. Every morning he got up to read the Bible and pray, and in his work and studies he acted with integrity and honesty. He understood that only through fearing God could he find true blessing in life.

One day Zhihan faced an important exam, and he was very nervous and worried. Yet he did not give up his reverence for God; he kept praying and believing in God’s help. On exam day he was willing to admit his own inability and rely on God’s strength. The result was a score better than he had expected, which was God’s blessing.

This story tells us that if we treat the fear of God as the compass of our lives, we will be blessed. Fearing God helps us understand that we need to rely on His wisdom and guidance to face difficulties and challenges. When we seek God’s will with a reverent heart, He will surely open the way for us and lead us toward success.

Dear family, let us face every situation in life each day with a reverent heart. Let us walk with God and trust His power and care. Whatever difficulties we meet, as long as we fear God, He will bless our lives.
ah: “Dear family, peace to you. Let us put into practice together today’s Soul Snack action guide. According to Psalm 128:4, those who fear Yahweh will be blessed! This is God’s promise to us, and also a direction we can practice in daily life.
a: Revere God with Respect
Honoring and revering God is one expression of fearing God. In daily life we can express our reverence through prayer, Bible reading and drawing near to the Lord.
Humble Obedience
Fearing God is not just being afraid of Him; more importantly it is obeying His will. At work, at home and in social life, show our reverence for God with humility and an attitude of serving others.
Hold Fast to Faith
Standing firm in faith without wavering is a form of fearing God. Whatever adversity or temptation comes, stand firm in faith and believe that God will surely bless those who fear Him.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for giving us this precious passage. Help us revere You in daily life, humbly obey Your will, and hold fast to our faith without wavering. May we be witnesses who fear God and are blessed, and may Your light shine upon us. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus, amen.”
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you: may you be continually blessed on the path of fearing God, and may everything you do receive abundant grace and blessing. Amen.

v: Yet he also is wise, and will bring disaster, and will not call back his words, but will arise against the house of the evildoers, and against the help of those who work iniquity.
b: This passage reminds us that God is a God of boundless wisdom. He can foresee the future, discern right from wrong, and grasp the whole picture of all things. Everything He does rests on His perfect wise decisions, and He does not change His plan.

In our lives we often meet all kinds of difficulties and challenges, and sometimes we may feel confused and helpless. But let us remember that God is the source of wisdom; He knows the best road and plan. Like a wise navigation system, He can guide us on the right way, even if at times we do not understand His decisions.

There was once a young woman named Xiuli who met many hardships and setbacks in life. Her family was not well off, and she had to work hard to pay for tuition and living expenses. One day she learned that her work contract was going to be cancelled, and she felt very discouraged and helpless. She asked herself, “God, why do so many difficulties keep happening to me?”

Yet in her darkest hour, Xiuli decided to trust God’s wisdom. She began to read the Bible and seek God’s guidance and comfort. She came to understand that even though she could not make sense of her present trouble, God’s wise plan was at work. She put down her anxiety and began to believe that God would bring her a better way out.

A few weeks later, Xiuli received a completely unexpected job offer. This job not only provided enough income to support her life, but also gave her more room to develop. Xiuli was delighted and grateful, because she understood that this was a display of God’s wisdom and grace.

Friends, sometimes we may not be able to understand what happens in life, but we can rest assured that God’s wisdom surpasses our thinking and understanding. He knows the best way to lead us, even in adversity. Let us learn, like Xiuli, to trust God’s wisdom and believe that He will lead us to a better future.
ah: “Dear family, peace to you. Let us put into practice together today’s Soul Snack action guide:
a: Before each day begins, quietly ask the LORD to give us wisdom so that we can face the day’s challenges and choices wisely.
In dealing with others, remember that the LORD is wise; treat others with tolerance and generosity, and look at matters with the eyes of wisdom.
In facing difficulties and setbacks, do not give up easily; instead think of wise ways to respond, and face adversity with faith.
When making decisions or choices, first seek the LORD’s will and listen to His wise guidance, so that our choices accord with God’s heart.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for giving us wisdom and guidance. Help us to be full of wisdom in daily life, to make right choices with Your wisdom, and to guard our hearts in difficult times. May we be channels that pass on Your wisdom and love, and may our lives glorify Your name. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus, amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you see God’s wise plan in every difficulty. Amen.

v: “With God is wisdom and might. He has counsel and understanding.
b: In this passage we see that God is full of wisdom and power. He has infinite wisdom, sees through all things, and has unlimited power to accomplish His purpose. This is an amazing truth, and a comforting one.

In our lives we often meet all kinds of challenges and difficulties. We may feel lost, helpless or without direction. But when we remember God’s wisdom and power, we can entrust ourselves to Him with peace of mind.

Like a wise navigator who always has detailed sea charts and rich navigational knowledge when sailing, God is the navigator of our lives. He knows the needs of each one of us and always leads us on the right road.

Like a person lost in a forest who does not know which way to go. But a wise guide appears, one who knows how to get through the forest, and leads the person to find the way home. This guide has rich knowledge and experience and can make sure they return home safely.

In the same way, God is the wise guide in our lives. When we lose our way, we only need to rely on Him with peace of mind, and He will lead us to the right path. He knows the needs of each one of us, and in our hardest moments He gives us wisdom and strength.

My friends, whatever challenge or difficulty you are facing now, remember that God is wise and powerful. He knows your needs, and He is able to help you. Just believe in Him and entrust your difficulties to Him, and He will surely open the way for you and give you wisdom and strength.
a: Ask for Wisdom
At the start of each day, pray and ask God to give us wisdom, to help us act wisely in every situation.
Study the Bible
Read the Bible daily, looking for treasures of wisdom and knowledge, and think about how to apply them in life.
Associate with Wise People
Humbly learn from wise Christians around you, and look for how they find wisdom in facing problems.
Love and Service
See yourself and others with the eyes of wisdom, care for others with love, and serve others in wise ways.
Self-Reflection and Growth
Before the day ends, reflect on what you did that day, and ask God to give us more wisdom and knowledge to help us grow day by day.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for giving us wisdom and power. Help us carry out these action guides in daily life and be witnesses of wisdom and knowledge. Shape our hearts, let us stand on Your truth, and live a life that reveres You. We pray in the name of Jesus Christ, amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you often experience God’s guidance and blessing on your path of seeking wisdom. May your heart be filled with faith, hope and love. Amen.

v: God is wise in heart, and mighty in strength. Who has hardened himself against him and prospered?
b: In this passage we see that God’s heart is full of wisdom and power. He is an all-wise and almighty God; there is nothing He does not know or cannot do. When we face difficulties, we can trust His wisdom and power, because He always has a solution.

Like a father with his children, God cares about our needs and is willing to help us. Once, in a small village, there was a poor family who could not pay for their child’s education. The father worried about it every day and felt powerless. But he still held on to faith and entrusted his difficulty to God. At last a kind person appeared who was willing to provide funds to support the child’s education. The father realized that God’s wisdom and power exceeded his own, and that he could trust God’s guidance to solve his problem.

This story tells us that when we face difficulties, we should not rely only on our own wisdom and ability, but turn to God. His heart is full of wisdom, He knows the best solution, and He is able to help us. When we hand our troubles to Him and trust His wisdom and power, He will open the way for us and let us experience prosperity.

Let us live out this truth in our daily lives. Whether at work, in study or in family life, when we meet challenges and difficulties, let us not lose heart but seek God’s wisdom and power. Believe that He will guide us to the best solution and grant the grace of prosperity. Walking with God, we can be full of faith, hope and love.
a: Pray Early
Each morning, connect with God, seek wisdom and guidance, and begin a good day.
Meditate on Scripture
In a busy life, find a moment to meditate on God’s word, and let the truth of wisdom guide our thoughts and behavior.
Do Good and Help Others
Look at the people around you with the eyes of wisdom, learn tolerance and generosity, and help brothers and sisters in need, showing God’s love.
Guard Your Words and Actions
In daily conversation stay gentle and wise, avoid quarrels and gossip, and use words to build others up and bring peace.
Gratitude and Praise
Always give thanks for God’s grace and wisdom in life, and offer praise and thanksgiving to God with a grateful heart.
pr: Dear Lord, thank You for giving us wisdom and power. Help us follow these action guides in daily life, and let us show Your glory and love by living wisely. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus, amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you face every difficulty with faith. May your heart be filled with God’s wisdom, and may you experience the grace of prosperity under His leading. Amen.

v: Daniel answered, “Blessed be the name of God forever and ever; for wisdom and might are his.
b: In this passage we see wisdom described as belonging to God’s power. This helps us understand that wisdom does not come only from human effort and study, but is a gift from God. And by drawing near to God we can experience and apply more deeply this wisdom that belongs to Him.

In our daily lives we often face all kinds of choices and challenges. Sometimes we may feel lost and helpless, not knowing what decision to make. At such times we need to understand that wisdom comes from God, and He is willing to give us wisdom to help us make the right choices.

There is a story that tells us about the power of wisdom. A young man lost himself in the pursuit of success and wealth. He was addicted to money and fame and neglected the needs of his family and friends. He became lonely and empty, not knowing how to find himself again.

Until one day he met a wise man. The wise man told him that true wisdom cannot depend only on wealth and outward success, but must grasp the true meaning and value of life. The wise man taught him to care for others and to share love and concern. The young man at last found inner peace and happiness again and became a person of wisdom and accomplishment.

This story reminds us that true wisdom is not in pursuing material satisfaction, but in caring for others and seeking inner joy. God is willing to give us the wisdom that belongs to Him, so that we can see the true meaning of life, make right choices, and influence others with love and care.

So let us come into God’s presence every day and ask Him to give us wisdom and strength to help us conduct ourselves in life. When we understand that wisdom comes from God and build a deep relationship with Him, we will find that life’s difficulties become easier and that we make choices in line with God’s heart.
ah: - Ask for wisdom: Each day, seek God’s wisdom and guidance in meditating on the Bible. Let God’s word be the standard of your life, helping you make wise choices. - Share wisdom: Share with brothers and sisters your insights and revelation from God’s word, encouraging and building one another up. This benefits not only yourself but also lets others receive the enlightenment of God’s wisdom. - Practice wisdom: Apply wisdom in daily life, showing the wisdom and power God has given in work, family and social settings. Prove your faith in and obedience to God by action.
pr:
Dear Heavenly Father,
Thank You for giving us wisdom and knowledge. Help us to seek Your wisdom every day and let Your word guide our steps. May we share Your wisdom in daily life, encouraging and building one another up. Help us practice wisdom so that our lives bring glory to You. We pray in the name of Jesus, amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you sense God’s presence and guidance on your journey of seeking wisdom. Like that young man, may you learn to care for others and to share love and concern, and be a witness to the wisdom God gives. Amen.

v: This also comes out from the LORD of Armies, who is wonderful in counsel, and excellent in wisdom.
b: In this passage we see that God’s wisdom is beyond compare. God’s wisdom far surpasses anything we human beings can understand; it is all-knowing and all-powerful.

Imagine a child lost in a forest, not knowing which way to go. Then a wise man comes to the child and hands him a carefully drawn map. The map marks all the paths and sights, so that the child can find his way home.

This is like God’s wisdom toward us. With His great and wonderful wisdom, He guides us to find solutions when we face difficulties in life. When we feel lost and helpless, we can trust God’s wisdom, and He will lead us onto the right path.

But sometimes we may question God’s wisdom, because we cannot understand what He does. Just as the child holding the map may not understand its symbols and directions, we may not fully understand God’s plan. Yet we need to believe that God is wonderful in counsel and that His wisdom far exceeds our imagination.

In life, when we face setbacks and trouble, let us remember God’s wisdom. He knows what we need, and He knows how to lead us out of trouble. Although we may not understand His plan, trusting God’s wisdom gives us faith, so that we can lift up our heads and keep going.

Let us ask God for wisdom every day and rely on His guidance. When we face choices, let us quiet our hearts and listen to God’s voice, and He will give us wisdom and clear direction. Whatever challenges and trials we face, God’s wisdom is our help and protection.
a: Seek Wisdom
Each morning, before beginning a new day, take time to meditate and pray, asking God to give you wisdom and discernment so that you can see things through the eyes of God’s wisdom.
Learn to Listen

When you interact with others, actively listen to their opinions and ideas, and do not rush to express your own views. By listening you can better understand the other person’s position and respond with wisdom and patience.
Take Practical Action
In daily life, when you face a choice, make your decision with God’s wisdom. Do not be only a hearer but a doer, letting wise conduct be reflected in your words and actions.
Join It to Faith
Join wisdom with faith, stand firm on the foundation of faith, and show God’s wisdom in life, becoming a witness to those around you.
Make Good Use of Opportunities
When you face choices or difficulties, remember that wisdom comes from God, and show the greatness and wonder of God’s wisdom in your actions.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for giving us wisdom and discernment in our lives, so that we pursue Your wisdom in daily life. Help us learn to listen, take practical action, join faith with wisdom, and make good use of opportunities, so that we may be Your witnesses. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus, amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you experience God’s wisdom every day. May you understand that His plan surpasses your imagination, and face the challenges of life with faith, hope and love. Amen.

v: “Behold, God is mighty, and doesn’t despise anyone. He is mighty in strength of understanding.
b: In this passage we see God’s great power and wisdom. God is almighty; He does not look down on us human beings, but instead guides us with vast wisdom.

In life we often face all kinds of challenges and difficulties. Sometimes we may feel helpless and desperate, not knowing how to solve the problem. But let us remember that God’s wisdom is without end, and He can give us wisdom and guidance.
A young architect was designing a large building, but he ran into a problem: how to build a solid building in this region. He tried all kinds of methods, but none succeeded.

In despair, he decided to ask God for help. He prayed and laid down his pride and self-assurance. One night he had a strange dream. He dreamed he was standing on a mountaintop and saw the whole panorama of the city. Suddenly he understood a way to solve the problem.
The next day he immediately changed his building plan and followed the direction from the dream. In the end he successfully built a sturdy and durable building, and became a model to his colleagues.

This story reminds us that when we face difficulties, we should turn to God for help. God’s wisdom is immeasurably vast, and He can show us the way to solve problems in many ways. But we need to be humble and obedient, and believe that God’s wisdom can lead us out of difficulty.

So whatever difficulty you are facing, remember that God’s wisdom is vast. Believe that He can give you wisdom and guidance and help you find a solution. Do not look down on yourself, because God’s wisdom can exceed our imagination.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you: may God’s wisdom fill your heart, guide your every step, and bring faith, hope and love. Amen.

v: Oh the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and the knowledge of God! How unsearchable are his judgments, and his ways past tracing out!
b: This verse reminds us that God’s wisdom is profound and cannot be measured. With our limited thoughts and abilities, we cannot fully understand God’s wisdom and knowledge, because God’s thinking goes far beyond what we can imagine. Yet this is also the source of our reverence and faith in God.

It is like a person standing at the seashore, gazing at the boundless ocean. He tries to understand the vastness and depth of the sea with his limited vision, but he can never fully grasp it. In the same way, each of us is such a small being, and trying to understand God’s wisdom is as hard as trying to understand the sea.

However, this does not mean that we know nothing of God’s wisdom. God reveals His wisdom and knowledge to us so that we can know Him with our limited ability. We can understand God’s wisdom more deeply by reading the Bible, through prayer and devotions, and by sharing what we have learned with other Christians.

When we begin to understand God’s wisdom, we will discover its beauty and mystery. We will learn the importance of faith, because we believe God has a plan for every step of our lives. We will learn the value of hope, because we know that whatever difficulty we face, God’s wisdom can lead us out of it. We will learn the power of love, because God’s wisdom teaches us how to love others as ourselves and not to hurt others lightly.

Let us keep pursuing God’s wisdom in daily life and apply this wisdom to everything we do. Whether in work, family, studies or relationships, God’s wisdom can guide us to make right decisions and to show love and compassion to others.
a: Fear God
In daily life keep a heart that fears God, respecting God’s authority and wisdom, and obeying His commandments and teaching.
Face Challenges Honestly
In daily life, face difficulties and challenges bravely, do not run from problems, but stand firmly on the side of truth and justice.
Treat People with Love
Learn generosity and forgiveness, show love and empathy to others, and help others know God’s wisdom and lead them onto the right path.
Learn to Listen
Listen to others’ opinions and advice with a humble heart, gain wisdom and knowledge from them, and keep growing and improving.
Bravely Make Changes
Whether in life habits or ways of thinking, bravely make changes, pursue higher values and goals, and let God’s wisdom fill your life.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for leading me to fear God and for giving us rich wisdom and knowledge. Help us put this wisdom into practice in daily life, face challenges with love and humility, and listen to the opinions of others. May we bravely make changes, accept Your leading, and let Your wisdom guide our every step. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus, amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you gain faith, hope and love in the process of pursuing God’s wisdom. Amen.

v: to the intent that now through the assembly the manifold wisdom of God might be made known to the principalities and the powers in the heavenly places,
b: In this passage we see that God’s plan is to display His wisdom through the church. God has wisdom of many kinds, including His wisdom in creating the universe, His wisdom in accompanying the Israelites through history, and also His wisdom in His relationship with each of us personally.
This wisdom is not merely an accumulation of learning or knowledge, but a wisdom that transcends the world and comes from God. When we become part of the church, we too can share in this wisdom.

Just as a gardener planting different flowers and trees needs different knowledge and skills to care for them, the church is also a garden God has planted in the world. Each person has different gifts and talents, and we work together and help one another to display God’s wisdom.

On the journey of life we may face all kinds of challenges and difficulties. But when we are connected with the church, we can receive the support and encouragement of others and face difficulties together. Just as a tree grows strong under the gardener’s care, we too can grow and develop under the protection of the church.

In the church we can learn God’s wisdom and apply it to every area of life. It is simply through interacting and learning with other Christians that we can understand it and apply it to our own lives.

Let us realize that God’s manifold wisdom exists not only in books and academic knowledge, but even more in our fellowship and sharing with one another. Let us have compassion for one another, build one another up and support one another, for the church is the place where God reveals wisdom.
ah: Practicing God’s wisdom in daily life:
a: Read the Bible and Pray
Spend time every day reading the Bible and praying, building an intimate relationship with God, and asking for the Holy Spirit’s guidance and revelation.
Listen to Teaching
At church gatherings, listen attentively to the pastor’s sermon and teaching, and learn how to apply God’s wisdom in life.
Fellowship and Sharing
Share with brothers and sisters your understanding of God’s word and your life testimony, encouraging and supporting one another.
Learn to Serve
Take part in the service work of the church, serve others with a humble heart, and learn God’s wisdom in practice.
Apply the Truth
Apply the truths of the Bible in daily life, including loving others as yourself, forgiving others and patience, so that God’s wisdom appears in your words and actions.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for helping us know God’s manifold wisdom. Help us learn and apply Your wisdom in daily life, so that through sharing in the church, learning to serve and applying the truth, people may see what You are doing in our lives. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus, amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you experience God’s wisdom in the church and bring this wisdom into your life. May you receive God’s guidance and wisdom in every challenge and difficulty. Amen.

v: Great is our Lord, and mighty in power. His understanding is infinite.
b: In this passage God shows us His limitless wisdom and power. We often meet difficulties and challenges in life, and sometimes we feel helpless and at a loss. But God’s wisdom is beyond anything we can understand; He can answer all our questions and give us guidance and direction.

Once there was a young artist who longed to create a perfect painting, but each time he was dissatisfied with his work. He was troubled and felt he lacked wisdom and ability. Until one day he met a wise teacher, who told him, “Art flows from within. If you trust your inner wisdom and express your feelings and ideas, you can create a truly unique work that is your own.”

This story tells us that God’s wisdom dwells within each of us. He has given us unique talents and abilities, and as long as we believe in and use these resources, we can create beautiful and meaningful things. Whatever difficulties and challenges we face, as long as we rely on God’s wisdom, He will surely lead us out of trouble.

In our daily lives we can also use this wisdom. For example, when we meet problems at work, we can think calmly and look for solutions; in relationships we can learn to be tolerant and understanding; when facing difficulties and setbacks, we can keep faith and hope, knowing that God’s wisdom always exceeds our own ability.
So let us treasure the wisdom God has given, believe in our abilities, and rely on God’s wisdom to lead our lives. May God’s blessing always be with you,
a: Before each day begins, humbly pray to God, asking Him to help us understand that His wisdom is beyond measure.
Read the Bible and think about the principles of wisdom God reveals in Scripture, seeking the Holy Spirit’s help to water our spiritual life.
In daily life, when facing choices and challenges, stop to think about how to respond with God’s wisdom, not relying only on our own insight or ability.
Learn to see God’s wisdom at work in the elders in ministry and in other believers, and imitate their faith and wisdom.
At the end of each day, reflect on what you have done and examine whether you followed the principles of God’s wisdom; if you strayed, ask God for forgiveness and help.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for giving us such immeasurable wisdom. Help us in daily life to experience the infinite depth of Your wisdom, and teach us to rely on Your wisdom rather than our own cleverness. May we show Your wisdom in all we do and be light and salt in the world. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus, amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. Amen.

v: LORD, how many are your works! In wisdom, you have made them all. The earth is full of your riches.
b: This passage reminds us that God created this world with His wisdom, filling it with endless beauty and abundance. Every detail and every life displays God’s great wisdom.

In our lives wisdom also plays an important role. Wisdom gives us the ability to make wise decisions and guides us in the right direction. Wisdom enables us to see the essence of things and to make choices that benefit ourselves and others.

There was a young man named Li Ming who was rather poor in his studies and always failed his classes. One day he met a wise teacher, who told him about the importance of wisdom. Li Ming began to learn how to use wisdom; he changed his study methods, focused on the key points, and sought help. As a result, his grades gradually improved, and his life became more successful and fulfilling.

In the same way, when we face difficulties and challenges in life, wisdom is our good teacher and friend. It can help us find ways to solve problems and lead us out of trouble. When we face choices, wisdom helps us distinguish right from wrong and choose the right path.

So in our lives, let us take wisdom as our guide. When we face difficulties, let us ask God to give us eyes of wisdom to see the essence of things and find a way to solve the problem. When we need to make a choice, let us judge by God’s wisdom and choose the right path.
a: Thanksgiving and Praise
Each day, stop at set times to think about how God made everything around us with wisdom. Through thanksgiving and praise, cultivate reverence for God and knowledge of His wisdom.
Seek Wisdom
Actively seek wisdom: keep learning, read the Bible and other helpful material to increase knowledge and insight, and apply wisdom in daily life.
Deal with People and Matters Wisely
When dealing with others, treat them with wisdom and love. Respect others’ opinions, tolerate different viewpoints, and consider all factors when deciding, making choices in a wise way.
Share Wisdom

Share with other believers your understanding and application of wisdom, and encourage one another to grow. You can also discuss in a small group how God’s wisdom is displayed in the Bible, and encourage one another to put it into practice in life.
Prayer and Leadership
In all things, seek God’s wisdom and guidance. Pray daily for God to give wisdom to guide us in difficulties and choices, and be a demonstration of God’s wisdom in life.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for making all things with Your wisdom, showing Your riches and wonder. Help us truly know Your wisdom in daily life, deal with people and matters wisely, and look to Your guidance and wisdom in all uncertainty. May we be witnesses of Your wisdom, and may our lives show Your glory. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you keep seeking wisdom in life and look at the world with the eyes of wisdom. May you make wise decisions that guide the journey of your whole life. Amen.

v: to him who by understanding made the heavens, for his loving kindness endures forever;
b: In this passage we see God called the One who made the heavens with wisdom. This reminds us that God is a Creator who has both power and wisdom. He created this beautiful heaven and earth, filling our lives with wonders and miracles.

In the same way, God has also given us wisdom. Wisdom is a precious gift that can guide us to right choices and decisions. At the same time, wisdom is also a process of learning, requiring us to keep seeking and growing.

Like a sailor on the sea who must rely on the stars and the compass to navigate, we need wisdom as our guide on life’s journey. When we face choices, wisdom will help us tell right from wrong, choose justice, and walk in God’s will.

We can draw wisdom from an old parable. A young farmer sowed seed in the spring, but impatiently dug it up every day to see whether it had sprouted. In the end, because the plants were disturbed so often, they could not grow strong. By contrast, another farmer waited patiently, giving the plants the sun, water and nutrients they needed each day. As a result he reaped an abundant harvest. This story reminds us that in life we also need patience and wisdom to nurture healthy relationships, careers and faith.

And this wisdom must exist together with love. Wisdom and love are twins that complement each other. A relationship built on wisdom but lacking love becomes cold and selfish. Conversely, a relationship based on love but lacking wisdom becomes blind and chaotic. Therefore, when we use wisdom, let us take love as the standard and treat others with respect, care and tolerance.

Finally, let us remember that God’s lovingkindness endures forever. Whether or not we have enough wisdom, in every situation God’s lovingkindness is eternal and unchanging. When we lose our way and do not know how to choose, God’s lovingkindness is with us, giving us strength and courage.
a: Be Aware of God’s Wisdom
At the start of each day, meditate on how God’s wisdom is displayed in creation, and think about how this wisdom affects your life.
Thank the Creator
In prayer, express gratitude for God’s wisdom and lovingkindness, and extol His power in creating all things.
Look for the Marks of Wisdom
In daily life, make an effort to look for traces of God’s wisdom, for example discovering His wise works in natural scenery, in relationships or in hardship.
Practice Wisdom
Through your conduct and decisions, show a way of life based on God’s wisdom, seeking to walk with Him in every situation.
Share God’s Grace
By sharing this passage with others, remind them to be thankful for God’s wisdom and lovingkindness. Testify with your own life to God’s love for you.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for creating all things with wisdom and lovingkindness. Grant us to know and follow Your wisdom, so that in daily life we reflect Your holiness and love. May we always be grateful for all You have done for us, look at the world with eyes of wisdom, and share God’s grace with others. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus, amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you feel God’s wisdom and love in your life. May you walk with God on your journey of seeking wisdom and handle things with love. May you obey God’s will in every choice and decision, and enjoy His boundless lovingkindness. Amen.

v: By wisdom the LORD founded the earth. By understanding, he established the heavens.
b: This passage reminds us that God created the whole world and founded the earth with His wisdom. God’s wisdom is without end, so we too should pursue wisdom in life.

Wisdom helps us make wise choices, and in all kinds of situations it lets us see the essence of things and judge rightly. Just as a wise captain in a storm uses his wisdom and experience to bring his ship safely across the sea, we need wisdom to guide us onto the right path.

Besides helping us make fitting choices, wisdom also lets us understand the meaning and purpose of life. Just as a famous architect uses his intelligence to decide a house’s structure and design, we can use wisdom to build a life with purpose and meaning. Only by understanding God’s wisdom can we understand our purpose in this world.

Hope is a quality we need when we face difficulties. Like a delicate flower blooming in the wilderness, even when the conditions are not ideal, it can still flourish in hardship. When we meet challenges and adversity, we can find the power of hope through the guidance of wisdom. We can believe God’s promise, knowing that He walks with us in difficulty and leads us to victory.

Love is the foundation for building and maintaining relationships. Like members of a loving family who care for and support one another, their love lets every family member feel accepted and cherished. We too should look at others with the eyes of wisdom and treat them with love. This love can change the world and bring hope and comfort to others.

So on our journey of pursuing wisdom, let us not forget faith, hope and love. When we trust the God who founded the earth by wisdom and established the heavens by understanding, God’s will shall be displayed in our lives.
a: Quiet Prayer Each Day
Each morning and evening, take time to quiet your heart and pray, seeking wisdom and understanding from God, and asking for His guidance and protection.
Read and Meditate
Read the Bible every day, especially the passages in Proverbs about wisdom and understanding, reflect on the truths in them, and think about how to apply them to your own life.
Learn to Decide Carefully
When you face choices and challenges in life, do not act rashly; think carefully and pray, then make a wise choice, relying fully on God’s wisdom.
Befriend the Wise
Associate with people of wisdom and understanding, encouraging and teaching one another, supporting one another in life, and building one another up and growing together in fellowship.
Witness by Conduct
Show God’s wisdom and understanding in your words and conduct, setting a good example for others so that they see God’s glory.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for giving us wisdom and understanding so that we can see Your works and guidance in our lives. Help us to pray quietly every day, read and meditate on Your word, decide carefully, befriend the wise, and witness to Your wisdom in word and deed. May our lives show Your glory and be witnesses of Your wisdom. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus, amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you find faith, hope and love in wisdom, and show God’s glory in your life. Amen.

v: God has made the earth by his power. He has established the world by his wisdom, and by his understanding has he stretched out the heavens.
b: This passage reminds us that in creating this world God used not only infinite power, but also His wisdom and understanding to build a beautiful universe.

In our lives wisdom is also indispensable. Every day we face all kinds of choices and challenges, and only by relying on God’s wisdom can we make right and wise choices and build a solid and harmonious life.

Let us imagine an architect who used his wisdom and intelligence in designing a great bridge. He considered all kinds of factors, including the choice of materials, the strength of the structure and the prevention of risks. In the end, he successfully built a stable and reliable bridge connecting people on both shores. This bridge symbolizes the difficulties and obstacles we face in life, and the architect’s wisdom is the divine wisdom we can rely on.

In the same way, when we meet challenges, we can turn to God and ask for His wisdom and understanding. In every choice and decision, let us ask ourselves, “Is this in line with God’s wisdom?” If we build our lives by God’s wisdom, we can build a world that is firm, harmonious and full of hope.
Now let us meditate together on this passage and open our hearts to God, letting His wisdom guide our every step.
a: In Daily Life, Create a Good Environment with Wisdom
At work, in study or at home, do your best to use wisdom to help others, solve problems and build a harmonious atmosphere.
Build Relationships with Wisdom
Be tolerant, understanding and respectful of others, use wisdom when getting along with people, promote harmonious relationships and cultivate a culture of mutual respect.
Live Out the Values of Wisdom
Think carefully when making decisions, do not be easily swayed by outside influences, hold fast to truth and justice, and be an example to those around you.
Seek Good Wisdom
