Face others with the wisdom of goodwill, showing patience and forgiveness. In every interaction, do your best to find the good in others and respond with love.
Learn Actively to Grow in Wisdom
Keep pursuing knowledge, wisdom and understanding. Read Scripture, books and learning resources, and keep improving your insight and skills.
pr: Dear Lord, grant us wisdom so that we can reflect Your glory in daily life. Lead us to build a good environment and harmonious relationships with wisdom, to live out the values of uprightness and righteousness, to seek good wisdom, and to learn actively and grow in wisdom. May we be Your witnesses, spreading love and peace in the world. Amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you use God’s wisdom in your life and build a world full of faith, hope and love. Amen.

v: “He has made the earth by his power. He has established the world by his wisdom. By his understanding he has stretched out the heavens.
b: This passage reminds us that God is the Lord of creation, and that He created this beautiful world with His power and wisdom. But beyond this, the passage also contains an important message: the importance of wisdom in our lives.

Everyone longs to have wisdom, because wisdom can guide us to make right choices, solve problems and succeed in life. Just as God established the world by wisdom, we too need wisdom to build our lives.

But what is true wisdom? Some think wisdom is merely an accumulation of knowledge and learning, but we must understand that true wisdom goes beyond knowledge itself. True wisdom comes from inner understanding and insight, which lets us grasp the meaning and purpose of life.

There was a young man named Weiming, who was very smart and talented. He achieved excellent grades in his studies and success in his career. Yet although he seemed to have everything, he felt empty and lost inside.

One day Weiming met an old wise man, who told him that true wisdom comes from understanding love and care. He explained that wisdom is not only about one’s own achievements and interests; it also includes caring for and helping others.

The old wise man told Weiming a parable. A seed can grow strong only when it receives enough water and sunlight in the soil. In the same way, our lives also need the nourishment of wisdom, and this wisdom comes from love and care.
Only when we learn to care for others and help them can we truly experience the power of wisdom. This wisdom not only helps us build firm relationships but also brings peace and joy to our hearts.

Let us use wisdom in life, not only for our own benefit but for the good of others. When we look at the world through the eyes of wisdom, we will be able to build a better and more harmonious society.
a: Appreciate the Wisdom of Creation
When we look at the wonders of nature, let us reflect on and marvel at the wisdom and power of God in creating all things. Cultivate a longing for and reverence of wisdom in daily life.
Handle Relationships with Wisdom
Learn to resolve conflict with wisdom and maintain harmonious relationships. Look at others with love and wisdom, and strive to be a peacemaker.
Seek Spiritual Wisdom
Ask God to give us spiritual wisdom to help us understand His heart and live a wise life. Use wisdom to set priorities and focus on eternal things.
Rely on the Holy Spirit’s Guidance
When you meet a hard problem, pray earnestly for God’s wisdom. Believe that the Holy Spirit will surely give heavenly understanding and wisdom, and sound judgment.
Spread the Gospel with Wisdom
Share the gospel with the people around you in a wise way, because God’s wisdom surpasses human wisdom. Answer doubts with wisdom and lead souls to the truth.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for the wisdom and power with which You created all things; may we appreciate and revere Your wisdom. Grant us spiritual wisdom, help us handle relationships, and rely on the Holy Spirit’s guidance to live a wise life. Help us share the gospel with wisdom and lead more souls to know You. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus, amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you look at the world with the eyes of wisdom every day, and influence others with love and care. Amen.

t: The Lamb, Christ, Is Worthy of Wisdom
v: saying with a loud voice, “Worthy is the Lamb who has been killed to receive the power, wealth, wisdom, strength, honor, glory, and blessing!”
b: This passage speaks of the Lamb who was slain, our Lord Jesus Christ. He alone is worthy of all power, wealth, wisdom, might, honor, glory and blessing. Through His life, death and resurrection He reveals these glorious attributes.

In this world we often pursue power, wealth and wisdom. We long to have influence in our careers, to gain riches, and to have insightful knowledge. Yet these are worldly notions that easily lead our hearts astray.

By contrast, the power, wealth and wisdom that Jesus Christ has are His from the beginning, not limited by worldly values. His authority comes from His dying for our sins, and His wealth is displayed in His love, grace and kindness. His wisdom surpasses human wisdom, and His plans and ways go far beyond what we can understand.

In our lives we need to take Jesus Christ as our model and example. When we pursue power, we should follow His humility and service; when we pursue wealth, we should follow His generosity and love; when we pursue wisdom, we should ask God to give us spiritual wisdom and rely on His guidance in every decision and action.

My friends, as we pursue power, wealth and wisdom, let us always remember that Jesus Christ is our example. He is worthy of all glory and blessing. When we imitate His life, we will be able to display His glory and bring faith, hope and love to the world.
ah: Living Out the Wisdom of Christ the Lamb
a: Read the Bible Often to Receive Wisdom
The Bible is the source of wisdom; we should learn humbly and grasp the wisdom in it. Apply the truth you receive in every area of life.
Imitate Christ’s Humble Wisdom
We should follow Christ’s example, learning from the Lord with a humble heart, not being proud or arrogant, and humbly accepting the counsel of others.
Gain Wisdom Through Spiritual Discipline
We need to practice often in the spirit, praying and reading the Bible to receive the Lord’s grace, in order to gain true wisdom. Those hungry in spirit will be satisfied.
Deal with People and the World with Wisdom
In relationships, learn to handle disputes and resolve conflict with wisdom. Counsel others with loving wisdom so that they are built up.
Serve the Lord Faithfully with Wisdom
The Lord has given us different gifts and talents; use wisdom to make good use of the gifts, serve the Lord faithfully and loyally, and become a vessel of honor.
pr: O Lord Christ, worthy of wisdom, You are the source of wisdom. Grant us a heart of wisdom and understanding, that we may read the Bible humbly and receive wisdom, imitate Your humility, gain wisdom through spiritual discipline, deal with people and the world with wisdom, and serve faithfully with what You have given. May we live out Your wisdom and be vessels of honor who glorify Your name. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. I hope you can take Christ as your example, and find true satisfaction and spiritual growth on your journey of pursuing power, wealth and wisdom. Amen.

v: saying, “Amen! Blessing, glory, wisdom, thanksgiving, honor, power, and might, be to our God forever and ever! Amen.”
b: “Amen! Blessing, glory, wisdom, thanksgiving, honor, power, and might be to our God forever and ever! Amen!” (Rev. 7:12)

In this verse we see that wisdom also belongs to God. It is a gift God gives us, and it continues without limit forever. In this world we often pursue wisdom and long to have intelligence and talent, but we must not forget that true wisdom comes from God.

Let us imagine a person who has excellent grades in school and a high IQ, but who lacks warmth and empathy. He may be able to solve difficult math problems, yet not know how to get along with people or how to care for others. Such wisdom is incomplete, because true wisdom should combine the head and the heart.

The Bible has many parables and stories that show us what true wisdom is. For example, in Jesus’ parable in Matthew 7:24–27, He tells us to build our faith on a solid foundation, like obeying God’s word. And the parable of the Good Samaritan in Luke 10:25–37 also tells us to bring love and care to those in need.

So true wisdom is not merely knowledge and talent, but something that can be applied in life and accomplish better things. This is the wisdom we should pursue, a wisdom that transcends the world and comes from God’s revelation.

Let us seek God’s wisdom every day, not only for our own benefit, but so that we can show love and care in our lives. When we have such wisdom, we can fit into God’s plan, become God’s instruments, and bring true hope and love to this world.
ah: Giving Wisdom to God
a: Humble Recognition
Remind yourself often that all wisdom comes from God. Our limited human wisdom is a grace that has been given, and we should not be proud or complacent.
Honor and Worship
When we receive God’s wisdom, we should honor the Source of wisdom, the Almighty God, with hearts of thanksgiving and worship.
Trust and Obey
In everything, first trust that God’s wisdom surpasses our understanding, then wholly obey the leading and arrangement of God’s wisdom.
Share and Proclaim
Those to whom God has given wisdom have a responsibility to share this wisdom with others, and to be witnesses and proclaimers of God’s wisdom.
Serve Wholeheartedly
Be willing to use the wisdom God has given with all your heart, to do your part for His kingdom and church, so that people may know this God who is worthy of wisdom.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, all wisdom, honor and power are graces You have given. Make us humble and aware at all times, honoring You, the Source of wisdom, with hearts of thanksgiving and worship. Let us trust and obey Your leading completely, be willing to share and proclaim Your wisdom, and serve You with all our hearts, so that more people may know You and give glory to You, the God worthy of everlasting praise. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you be full of faith and hope in your pursuit of true wisdom, and show God’s love in your life. Amen.

v: But we speak God’s wisdom in a mystery, the wisdom that has been hidden, which God foreordained before the worlds for our glory,
b: In this verse we see God’s mysterious wisdom. This wisdom was foreordained by God before the ages, and it is so profound and yet so wonderful. Sometimes we ask ourselves: why do some things happen to us? Why do we have to face difficulties and challenges? Perhaps the answer is here: God’s wisdom has already ordained us to glory.

A farmer sows seed in his field. He rises early and works hard, tilling the soil and planting all kinds of crops. After a few months he sees the seedlings come up, green and full of life. But these seedlings must go through the washing of wind and rain and the scorching of the hot sun. The farmer knows that these hardships and challenges are necessary, because only so can the seedlings grow strong and bear beautiful fruit.

Our lives are like these seedlings. God has sown seeds of wisdom in our lives. Sometimes we meet the washing of wind and rain, and experience setbacks and trouble in life. But we should understand that these difficulties are ordained by God for the sake of our glory. Just as seedlings need the washing of wind and rain to grow, we too need to go through hardship in order to grow and show God’s wisdom.

There was an athlete who suffered many failures and injuries in competition. But he did not give up; instead he trained himself even more resolutely. In the end he won the championship and became an outstanding athlete. This athlete understood that only by going through failure and setbacks could he learn real wisdom, achieve success and gain true glory.

In the same way, when we face difficulties and challenges in life, let us not lose heart. On the contrary, let us firmly believe that God’s wisdom has already ordained that we will be glorified in the future. Just as the farmer must wait patiently for the seedlings to grow, we too need to believe that behind every difficulty God’s wisdom is guiding us.
ah: Receiving God’s Mysterious Wisdom
a: Call on God Humbly
Always pray to God with a humble heart, admit your ignorance and limits, and earnestly ask God to give heavenly wisdom and revelation.
Meditate Carefully on God’s Word
Study the Bible diligently, carefully grasp the mysteries and wisdom hidden in it, and store God’s truth deep in your heart so that it becomes a spring of wisdom for life.
Rely on the Holy Spirit’s Guidance
Pray and seek the Holy Spirit’s illumination and guidance of our thoughts and minds, and believe by faith that the Holy Spirit will surely give heavenly wisdom and judgment.
Live a Life of Wisdom
Put the wisdom you receive into daily life, use wisdom to handle relationships and all kinds of problems, and be a witness of the fragrance of Christ.
Share Experiences of Wisdom
Share with other believers the wisdom and experiences God has given, exhorting and building one another up, so that everyone may know and personally experience God’s mysterious wisdom.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, before the ages You foreordained us to glory. Help us call on You humbly, meditate carefully on the mysteries and wisdom in Your word, rely on the Holy Spirit’s guidance at all times, witness well for You by living wisely, and share with all believers the experiences of wisdom You have given, so that in Your mysterious wisdom we may keep receiving revelation and guidance, and live a blessed life forever. We pray in the holy name of the Lord Jesus Christ, amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. In every challenge and difficulty, may you firmly believe that God’s wisdom has already ordained you to glory. Like the seedlings, may you grow strong in the wind and rain and bear beautiful fruit. May you learn true wisdom in life, grow spiritually and be victorious in life, and receive eternal glory in God’s kingdom. Amen.

v: For seeing that in the wisdom of God, the world through its wisdom didn’t know God, it was God’s good pleasure through the foolishness of the preaching to save those who believe.
b: In this world wisdom is pursued by many. We often think our knowledge and wisdom are enough to solve every problem. Yet the Bible tells us that the wisdom of the world cannot let us truly know God.

But God’s wisdom is completely different from the wisdom of the world. God’s wisdom is not built on human wisdom, but saves those who believe through the message of the cross, which people consider foolish.

Let us explain this truth with a parable. Imagine a tree towering into the clouds, representing the wisdom of the world. Although this tree looks strong, it is only illusory and short-lived. When the storm comes, the tree may be blown down and give no real protection.

By contrast, God’s wisdom is like a sturdy house built on a stable foundation. Even if the world collapses, this house still stands and gives us a true refuge. Through faith and hope, we can find peace and protection in God’s wisdom.

Let us bring this attitude into our lives, holding on to faith, hope and love in the face of every difficulty and challenge. When we are in trouble, let us not rely only on our own wisdom, but humbly call on God and seek His wisdom and guidance.
ah: 1. Humbly know God: Realize that human wisdom is limited, humbly accept God’s wisdom, and actively seek God’s will. 2. Pray often: Spend time every day communicating with God in prayer, seeking His wisdom to face life’s challenges and choices. 3. Listen carefully: Listen to God’s voice in stillness, and come to know God’s wisdom and plan through the Holy Spirit’s guidance. 4. Take the Bible as the standard: Read the Bible actively, apply God’s word to daily life, and let His truth guide our actions and thoughts. 5. Show faith by action: Do not stop at the level of knowledge, but put God’s wisdom into action, showing faith and obedience in life.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for giving us Your wisdom, so that we may have the right direction and decisions in life. Help us humbly obey Your will, and seek Your wisdom and guidance every day. May our lives be a witness to Your glory. We pray in the name of Jesus, amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you receive God’s wisdom in your daily life, and go forward in the light of faith, hope and love. Amen.

v: but to those who are called, both Jews and Greeks, Christ is the power of God and the wisdom of God;
b: In this verse we see Christ described as the power and wisdom of God. This makes us think about a question: what is true wisdom? Many people in the world pursue wisdom; they study knowledge and seek achievement, but can this worldly wisdom bring us real benefit?

There was a young man who was very clever and spent much time studying and pursuing knowledge. His grades were excellent, and many people envied him. Yet he felt empty inside; his wisdom did not bring him real happiness and satisfaction.

One day he met a wise pastor. The pastor told him that true wisdom comes not only from learning and achievement, but from a relationship with God. Christ is the way; He is the power and wisdom of God.

The young man decided to seek God’s wisdom. He began to read the Bible, pray and follow Christ’s teaching. As time passed, he gradually discovered that walking with God brought him true peace and joy. The wisdom of the world may bring momentary success, but only God’s wisdom can give us true hope and love. In this world full of pursuit of knowledge and achievement, we need to remember that Christ is the source of God’s power and wisdom. Only through a relationship with God can we truly gain wisdom. When we make Christ the center, our lives will be full of faith, hope and love.
ah: 1. Know Christ’s identity: Know that Christ is not only our Savior but also the source of God’s power and wisdom. 2. Receive Christ’s power: Realize that Christ is the power of God; whether we are Jews or Greeks, we can rely on His power to live. 3. Rely on Christ’s wisdom: Know that Christ is also the wisdom of God, so when we face challenges and choices in life, we can rely on His wisdom to guide our direction. 4. Show faith by action: Do not stop at the level of knowledge, but turn faith in Christ into action, living out obedience and trust toward Him. 5. Witness to Christ in different cultures: Whatever cultural background we come from, we can bear witness to His power and wisdom by living out the life of Christ.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for letting us know that Christ is the power and wisdom of God, and for giving us power and wisdom through Christ. May we rely on Your power and wisdom in our daily life and live out faith in and obedience to You. Help us to be Christ’s witnesses in different cultures, so that Your name may be glorified throughout the earth. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus, amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you receive God’s blessing and strength in the pursuit of true wisdom. Amen.

v: Because of him, you are in Christ Jesus, who was made to us wisdom from God, and righteousness and sanctification, and redemption,
b: This passage reminds us that we are not only in Christ, but that our wisdom, righteousness, holiness and redemption all come from God. What a wonderful gospel! In this world we often meet all kinds of challenges and difficulties, but we can be at ease, because we have Christ Jesus as our wisdom.

A captain was leading a ship through a storm. The other ships were tossed about by wind and waves, but only this ship came safely to rest near the shore. When the other ships asked how he had succeeded, he said, “Because I have a wise helmsman, Jesus Christ. I prayed and sought His guidance, and He led us, keeping us away from danger and bringing us safely to shore.”

In the same way, when we have Christ Jesus as our wise helmsman, we can find direction and peace in life. He will guide us away from enticements and temptations and help us make right decisions. He not only gives us wisdom, but also becomes our righteousness, holiness and redemption. His love and grace enable us to walk the right road and enjoy eternal redemption.

So let us rely on the wisdom of Christ Jesus every day, and in all our choices and difficulties seek His guidance and help. Whatever we meet, let us remember that Christ Jesus is our true wisdom, and He brings us faith, hope and love.
ah: “Dear family, peace to you. Let us put into practice together today’s Soul Snack action guide:”
a: 1. Be united with Christ: Seek a relationship with Christ, deepening our connection with the Lord through prayer, Bible reading and worship. 2. Rely on God’s strength: In daily life, rely on God’s wisdom, understand that our wisdom comes from God, and ask Him to help us make wise choices. 3. Live out God’s virtues: In how we live, show the likeness of Christ, pursue righteousness and holiness, and let God’s wisdom be displayed in our lives. 4. A godly life: Take Christ as our redemption, and live out a godly character in daily life, with sincere love and reverence toward God and others. 5. Receive redemption: Thank God for the redemption He has given us in Christ, understand that this redemption brings eternal life and grace, and therefore fear God in everything.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for giving us wisdom, righteousness, holiness and redemption in Christ Jesus. Help us to be united with Christ and receive Your redemption, to rely on Your wisdom in daily life, to live out a godly character, and to show Your glory. May we seek Your will in everything. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus, amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you conduct yourself in the wisdom of Christ Jesus, seek His will, and receive strength and peace in His love. Amen.

v: “God understands its way, and he knows its place.
b: In the life of each one of us we meet many choices and problems. Sometimes we feel confused and lost, not knowing which road is best to take. But remember: God understands the way of wisdom, and He knows where wisdom is found.

There was a young man who lost himself in the pursuit of success and wealth. Every day he was busy at work, chasing the dream of money, while neglecting his own inner worth. One day he met a wise man, who told him a story.

A treasure was buried on a mountain. Many people tried to find it, but no one succeeded. The young man wanted this treasure too, so he hurried up the mountain to look for it. But he saw only barren land and steep mountain paths. He wandered on the mountain for a long time, but still found nothing.
At last, exhausted, he sat down on the mountaintop. Suddenly he saw a flourishing tree, tall and strong, with green leaves and solid fruit. He was amazed and asked the tree how it had grown.

The tree told him that whenever rain watered the ground, it absorbed the nutrients and turned them into its own strength and vitality. It did not hurry to grow tall or bear fruit, but focused on its own growth and development.

This story tells us that the way of wisdom is not in pursuing wealth and success, but in focusing on inner growth and development. Like that tree, we need to take in God’s word, devotional life and spiritual food in order to grow and bear good fruit.

When we face choices and confusion, remember that God understands the way of wisdom and knows where wisdom is found. By seeking God’s guidance and listening to His word, we can find the road of wisdom that is truly ours.
a: Reflect Before Each Day Begins
Each morning spend a few minutes reflecting on your plan of action, making sure it accords with the way of wisdom.
Seek Guidance
When you meet difficulty or a choice, it is good to seek advice from a wise person, to make sure you are walking on the right road.
Learn and Grow

Keep learning, and spend time every day reading the Bible, especially the wisdom books such as Proverbs and Ecclesiastes, looking in them for guidance for life. Attend lectures or courses to keep raising your level of wisdom.
Observe and Reflect
In daily life observe God’s creation, and learn wisdom from nature and from relationships.
Use Time Well
Arrange your time sensibly, avoid waste, and focus on what is important and valuable.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for giving us the way of wisdom. Help us put this wisdom into practice in daily life, so that every day we can walk on the right road. Lead us to seek guidance, learn and grow, observe and reflect on the way of wisdom, and use time well on what is of value. May we be children who please You and live out the wisdom You have given. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you: may you focus on inner growth and development in your pursuit of wisdom, and bear good fruit. Amen.

t: The Fear of the Lord Is Wisdom
v: To man he said, ‘Behold, the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom. To depart from evil is understanding.’”
b: In this passage God reminds us that the fear of the Lord is the root of wisdom, and that departing from evil is the mark of understanding. This is not only a simple lesson but also a principle for living.

Like a ship sailing on the sea, it needs a helmsman to lead it in the right direction so as to avoid danger. Our lives are the same: we need the fear of the Lord as our helmsman, guiding us to make right choices in this world.

To fear the Lord means to hold in awe God’s authority and holiness, and to be willing to follow His will. This reverence lets us stay calm and steady when we face difficulties, because we know that God is the source of wisdom and strength, and He will surely lead us toward the light.

On the other hand, departing from evil is the mark of understanding. When we keep away from things that entice us toward sin and destruction, we preserve our spiritual health and the proper working of our lives. This may mean staying away from bad friends or habits, and refusing to take part in harmful activities. Choosing to depart from evil is the best way to protect ourselves and our families.

But fearing the Lord and departing from evil are only a beginning. When we act with wisdom, we will seek to grasp God’s will and plan. Through prayer and Bible reading we can build a closer relationship with God, and He will give us wise guidance. May we seek God’s wisdom every day and let Him be the helmsman of our lives, leading us on the path of spiritual growth and blessing.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you keep growing on the path of fearing the Lord and departing from evil. May God’s wisdom lead you to make wise choices, and may His peace and joy be with you forever. Amen.

v: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom. All those who do his work have a good understanding. His praise endures forever!
b: In this passage we see that fearing God is the starting point of gaining wisdom. Wisdom is not merely an accumulation of knowledge, but an ability that guides us to act rightly and discern right from wrong. If we do not fear God, we cannot truly have wisdom.

Fearing God does not mean being afraid of Him or holding fear, but respecting, honoring and obeying Him. Only when we treat God with the right attitude can we truly open the door of wisdom. This means we respect God’s authority, keep His commands and act according to His ways.
In our daily lives we may face many difficulties and choices. Sometimes we may feel lost, not knowing what is right to do. But as long as we fear God, He will give us wisdom and understanding.

Like a navigator who must sail across the vast ocean and face unknown storms and dangers. But he is not afraid, because he trusts his compass, which points in the right direction and helps him sail smoothly. On the journey of our lives, God is our compass and His word is our guide. As long as we fear Him and keep His commands, we will find the right road.

Let us take the fear of God as our starting point and seek His wisdom and guidance. In our decisions, let us take His word as the standard and follow His will. When we do so, we are truly wise people, with the character of wisdom.
ah: 1. Fear Yahweh: Take the fear of God as the beginning of wisdom, which means we respect, revere and obey God’s commands and teaching. 2. Keep God’s commands: Wise people keep God’s commands, which means applying the Bible’s teaching in daily life and living out our faith. 3. Reflect on your conduct: Each day reflect on whether your conduct accords with God’s will, and humbly accept opportunities to change and grow. 4. Seek wisdom: In daily life keep seeking God’s wisdom and guidance, and before making a decision, consider whether it accords with God’s heart. 5. Grow together with other believers: Share the journey of faith with other brothers and sisters, encouraging and supporting one another and growing together in faith.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for giving us the beginning of wisdom and teaching us to fear You and keep Your commands. Give us strength and wisdom to live out Your will in daily life and to grow together with other believers. May we be together, encouraging one another and pursuing spiritual growth together. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus, amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you advance step by step on the path of fearing God and gain His wisdom and understanding. May your life be full of faith, hope and love. Amen.

v: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom. The knowledge of the Holy One is understanding.
b: This passage reminds us that to gain true wisdom, we must first fear God and know the Holy One. This means building an intimate relationship with God and continually seeking His guidance and wisdom in our daily lives.

Like a young carpenter’s apprentice who wants to learn how to make a beautiful table but has never touched woodworking tools or taken part in any woodworking project. But he has an experienced teacher, who not only teaches him how to use the tools but also shares much knowledge about woodworking techniques and design. Respecting his teacher and seeking his guidance, the apprentice gradually becomes an excellent master carpenter.

The same principle applies to our life of faith. When we honor God and know His attributes and truth, we can gain wisdom and understanding. It is not just about studying the Bible, but about applying God’s word to our lives and letting His truth be our guide.

Every day we face all kinds of choices and challenges. Sometimes we may feel confused and helpless. But when we handle these situations with a heart that fears God, we can rest assured that God will guide us and enable us to make wise decisions.

Just as a navigator sailing on the sea needs the stars to guide him, we need to fear and know the Holy One to guide the voyage of our lives. Then, whatever the wind and waves, we can press on steadfastly.
Let us remember that the fear of Yahweh is the beginning of wisdom, and knowing the Holy One is the source of understanding. Let us seek God and His wisdom daily and practice His truth in life.
ah: 1. Fear Yahweh: Taking the fear of God as the beginning of wisdom means respecting God, revering His authority and holiness, and treating Him with a reverent heart. 2. Know the Holy One: Wise people know the Holy One, which means we should strive to know God more deeply, deepening our relationship with Him through Bible reading, prayer and devotions. 3. Fear and knowledge together: Fearing God and knowing God complement each other; we should not only respect His authority but also understand His nature and heart. 4. Conduct as a reflection: Our fear and knowledge of God should be shown in our conduct, and our words and actions should accord with God’s will and teaching. 5. Keep learning and growing: Keep learning and growing, and seek a deeper realm of fearing and knowing God in life.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for giving us the beginning of wisdom. Help us to fear You in daily life and to strive to know Your holiness and authority. May our words and actions reflect our fear and knowledge of You, and may we keep learning and growing, knowing You more deeply. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus, amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you, with the wisdom of fearing and knowing the Holy One, keep growing in faith, hope and love. Amen.

v: Wisdom is supreme. Get wisdom. Yes, though it costs all your possessions, get understanding.
b: In this passage God calls us to pursue wisdom, because wisdom is the leader in our lives and can guide us on the right path. Just as a team needs a wise leader to lead them forward, each of us needs wisdom to guide our lives.

A young man resolved to become a successful entrepreneur, and he found a wise old man as his mentor. The old man told him, “If you want true success, first you need to gain wisdom. Wisdom is not only academic knowledge; it also includes wise choices and right values. Only with wisdom can you find true success in your career and relationships.”

The young man listened to the old man and decided to put everything aside and focus on pursuing wisdom. He read and studied, learned different areas of expertise, made friends with wise people, and went through many challenges and failures. But he learned precious lessons from every setback and gradually grew into a wise leader.

In the same way, God wants us to pursue wisdom as well. We can enrich our spiritual life by reading the Bible, praying and talking with people of deep faith. When we keep pursuing wisdom, God will surely give us understanding and guidance, helping us succeed in every area.
ah: 1. Seek wisdom: When we realize the value of wisdom, we should strive to seek it, growing in wisdom by reading the Bible, praying and talking with wise people. 2. Use what you have well: Wisdom enables us to manage everything we have wisely, including time, money and resources. We should use these resources wisely, to show God’s glory and benefit others. 3. Pursue understanding: Linked with wisdom is understanding. We should pursue understanding, making wise decisions through thinking, analysis and action, so as to succeed and grow in life. 4. Walk with wisdom: Walking with wisdom means bringing wisdom into our daily life, making it the basis of our thinking and action, and applying wisdom to each of our decisions and actions. 5. The values of wisdom: We should build values based on wisdom and use them in daily life to guide our conduct and decisions.
pr: Heavenly Father, thank You for giving us wisdom as the chief virtue. Help us to seek wisdom, use what we have well, and pursue understanding. May we walk with wisdom in life and build the values of wisdom, letting Your wisdom guide our every step. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus, amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you keep growing on your journey of pursuing wisdom and, like that young man, gain true success. May the light of wisdom shine on your hearts, and may your lives be full of faith, hope and love. Amen.”

v: Esteem her, and she will exalt you. She will bring you to honor when you embrace her.
b: In this world we often pursue all kinds of things, such as wealth, reputation and achievement. We long to succeed in life and be recognized and respected by others. Yet what truly brings us advancement and honor is not these outward things, but wisdom.

Wisdom is a precious resource that goes beyond common sense; she is like a bright star guiding us along the right road. When we choose to exalt wisdom, it means we are willing to put her at the center of our lives and act by her guidance. In this way wisdom will lead us beyond our limits and let us keep growing and progressing in life.

Let us imagine a scene from a person’s life. This person has wisdom as his guide; he knows how to make right decisions, how to build good relationships with others, and how to handle difficulties and challenges. He chooses not to be lured by material things but to put wisdom first, and this brings him success in his career. More importantly, he also finds happiness and harmony in his family and relationships.

Unlike the emptiness of material wealth, wisdom brings us true honor. When we let wisdom guide our words and deeds, we reflect a noble character and values. We will become examples to others and be respected and admired.

So let us strive every day to seek and guard wisdom. Like guarding precious treasure in a safe, we should store wisdom deep in our hearts and remain alert at all times. When we exalt wisdom, she will protect and guide us, and we will keep rising and being honored on life’s journey.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you take wisdom as your guide and keep rising and being honored in life. Amen.

v: Give your servant therefore an understanding heart to judge your people, that I may discern between good and evil; for who is able to judge this great people of yours?”
b: In this verse we see Solomon, king of Israel, praying to God, asking Him to give him wisdom and the ability to discern right from wrong. This story shows us how important wisdom is! Whether in personal life or in society, we need wisdom to make wise choices and judgments.

When we face difficulties and choices, asking God for wisdom is of the greatest importance. Just as Solomon knew he could not judge so many people alone, we too must admit our own limits and ignorance. But when we rely on God and ask Him to give us wisdom, He will surely answer our prayer.

In daily life we can also use wisdom to discern right from wrong. When we face choices, we can seek God’s guidance and find answers in His word. Just as a wise mother teaches her children to tell right from wrong, God’s wisdom can help us hold to the truth and make right choices.

Let us always remember that wisdom is not only a display of knowledge and reason, but above all a gift from God. When we humbly ask God for wisdom, He will surely give us the wisdom we need, so that we can judge rightly and tell right from wrong.
ah: 1. Think deeply: Spend time alone each day reflecting on your conduct and decisions, so as to judge right and wrong more clearly. 2. Learn knowledge: Keep learning, reading the Bible and other helpful books, to increase wisdom and insight. 3. Seek guidance: Talk with wise and experienced elders or mentors, and learn from their wisdom and insight. 4. Act with prudence: When facing a choice, think calmly, weigh the pros and cons, and do not act rashly, so as to avoid regrettable consequences. 5. Pray for God’s wisdom: Each day in prayer humbly ask God to give wisdom, to help us judge right and wrong.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for giving us this precious time to seek Your wisdom. Give us clear thinking and keen discernment, to help us judge right and wrong correctly in daily life and act with prudence. Lead us to walk in the way of justice and truth, and let us be a help and support to one another. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you receive God’s wisdom and guidance in every choice of life. May you love and serve others with wisdom, and find a direction for solving problems in difficulty. Amen.

v: When I applied my heart to know wisdom, and to see the business that is done on the earth (even though eyes see no sleep day or night),
b: In this verse we see a wise man who has a strong desire for wisdom. He does not pursue knowledge only on the surface, but seeks wisdom wholeheartedly. He understands that wisdom is not only knowing what is done on the earth, but, more importantly, how to use wisdom to guide our lives.

Everyone longs to have wisdom, because wisdom can help us make wise decisions, solve problems and influence our own lives and the lives of others. But how should we seek wisdom? Let us hear a story to inspire us.
There was once a young man named Rongxuan who had always wanted wisdom, but he did not know where to start. One day he met a wise man, who told him a parable.

The wise man said, imagine you are standing in a dark room and cannot see anything. But if you light a candle, its light will illuminate everything in the room. Wisdom is like that candle; it can light the road ahead of us.

Rongxuan suddenly understood. He realized that to have wisdom, he must first pursue wisdom wholeheartedly, just like lighting a candle. He began to read books of wisdom, seek wisdom’s guidance, and talk with wise people. Through constant learning and growth, he finally gained wisdom.

Dear family, let us also be like Rongxuan and pursue wisdom wholeheartedly. When we learn, think and seek God’s guidance with focus, we will be able to see what is done on the earth and guide our lives with wisdom.
a: Cultivate Observation
Observe the people and things around you, and ponder their mysteries with care. Pay attention to every little thing in life, and gain wisdom from it.
Read Diligently
Make good use of spare time to read good books and draw nourishment of wisdom from them. Do not limit yourself to textbooks; also read books on life, philosophy and other fields.
Ask Humbly
When you meet something you do not understand, do not stay stuck in your own ways; ask others humbly and draw on their wisdom. At the same time, be glad to share what you have learned with others.
Reflect and Examine
Set aside a moment each day to reflect on what you have done, examine whether it accords with wisdom, and keep improving yourself.
Practice What You Learn
Theory and practice are equally important. Only by applying the wisdom you have learned in life can you truly benefit.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for giving us the gift of wisdom. Help me cultivate observation and ponder every little thing in life with care. Help me also to read good books diligently and draw nourishment of wisdom from them. When I meet something I do not understand, make me humble to ask others, and glad to share what I have learned. Each day remind me also to reflect on and examine what I have done and keep improving myself. Finally, give me strength to apply the wisdom I have learned in life. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you: may you reap an abundant harvest on your journey of seeking wisdom, and may your life be full of God’s grace and leading because of wisdom. Amen.

v: He lays up sound wisdom for the upright. He is a shield to those who walk in integrity,
b: This passage reminds us that God gives true wisdom to those who are upright and pure in conduct, and makes wisdom their shield.

We now live in a world full of information and choices, and every day we face all kinds of decisions. Sometimes we may feel confused and lost, not knowing what is right to do. But when we seek God’s wisdom, He will surely protect us and guide us on the right path.

A man stood in a jungle, having lost his way and not knowing where to go. Suddenly he saw a wise man holding a shield on which were written the words “True Wisdom.” The wise man told him that as long as he held fast to uprightness and pure conduct, God’s wisdom would always be with him, protecting him and guiding him to the shore of light.

We can apply this story to our own lives. Sometimes we may face perplexity and uncertainty, not knowing what is right to do. But as long as we keep a sincere, upright and pure heart and seek God’s wisdom, He will surely give us answers and guidance, and protect us from the harm of evil.

So let us store up true wisdom every day, and take upright and pure conduct as our covering. When we face choices and difficulties, let us not forget to ask God for help and believe that He will lead us on the right path.
a: Seek True Wisdom
To become an upright person, you must first seek true wisdom. Begin each morning by meditating on the Bible, building an intimate relationship with God, and seeking the Holy Spirit’s guidance.
Pure Conduct
In daily life, keep upright and pure conduct. Avoid lying and slandering others, and strive to live in peace with people.
Protected by the Shield
When you face temptation or difficulty, trust in true wisdom as a shield to protect yourself. Hold on to faith, knowing that God’s wisdom can protect us from harm.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for giving us true wisdom. May we seek Your will every day, keep our conduct pure, and trust in Your protection. Help us put these teachings into practice in daily life and become people who please You. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus, amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you store up true wisdom every day, and find God’s protection and guidance in uprightness and purity. Amen.

v: He changes the times and the seasons. He removes kings and sets up kings. He gives wisdom to the wise, and knowledge to those who have understanding.
b: This verse reminds us that God is an all-wise and almighty Sovereign. He not only rules over time and power, but also gives wisdom to the wise and knowledge to those who have understanding. This makes us realize that in our lives God has complete power to hold everything.

Friends, have you ever met a hard decision? Or faced a problem you could not solve? At such times we need to call on God and seek His wisdom and guidance. God is glad to give us His wisdom, as long as we come before Him with a humble and lowly heart.

A young farmer was running a field. One day he faced the difficult question of which crop to plant. He began to worry that if he chose the wrong crop, his field might fail. So he decided to pray and ask God to give him wisdom.

After he prayed, an idea suddenly came to him. He recalled the wisdom his father had taught him in his childhood. He remembered his father telling him that, given the local climate and soil, this particular crop would grow better. So he decided to follow his father’s wisdom and planted this crop.

A few months later, when the crop had grown strong, he saw his field full of a rich harvest. He thanked God deeply for giving him wisdom and guiding him to make the right decision. This story tells us that when we seek God’s wisdom, He will answer us in many ways, including through the experience and wisdom of others.

Friends, whatever challenge or choice you face now, let us not forget to pray to God for wisdom. He has promised that in due time He gives wisdom to the wise and knowledge to those who have understanding. When we humbly seek His will, He will surely guide us on the right path.
a: Keep a Heart of Reverence
Always understand that all wisdom and knowledge are given by God, and so keep a heart of humility and reverence.
Learn Humbly
Keep learning new knowledge and skills, keep a longing to be given wisdom and knowledge by God, and practice diligently.
Discern Right from Wrong
Use the wisdom God has given to discern the essence of things, tell right from wrong and good from evil, and make right choices.
Serve Others
Use well the wisdom and knowledge God has given to benefit others, do your best in life and work, glorifying God and helping people.
Trust in God’s Power
Believe that God rules over times and seasons, and in difficulty and adversity rely on God’s wisdom and great power.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for giving us wisdom and knowledge. Make me always keep a heart of reverence, learn humbly, and work hard to grow in wisdom. Help me to discern right from wrong and make right choices with wisdom. Use me also, to serve others with the wisdom You have given. In whatever circumstances, make me rely on Your power that rules over all things and Your boundless wisdom. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. On your journey of seeking God’s wisdom, may He give you sound judgment, right choices and a peaceful heart. Amen.

v: For the LORD gives wisdom. Out of his mouth comes knowledge and understanding.
b: In this verse God shows us that He is the fountain of wisdom. Wisdom is a priceless gift that can guide our lives and help us make right choices. God gives us wisdom so that we may understand His will and act by His guidance in life.

In our lives we often meet many situations that need wisdom to solve. Perhaps you are facing an important decision and are not sure how to choose; perhaps you face difficulties and challenges and feel you cannot cope; perhaps you are lost and confused, not knowing which way to go. At such times we can call on God and ask Him to give us wisdom.

A young man met a wise man and wanted to get wisdom from him. The wise man took the young man to a lake, held his head under the water, and then asked him how much he longed to breathe when he needed air. The young man answered that when he could not breathe, he would long very much for air. The wise man told him that when he longed for wisdom like this, he would get it.

In the same way, when we truly long for wisdom and call on God, He will surely give us wisdom. But we also need to understand that wisdom is not merely knowledge and reason; it comes from a relationship with God and obedience to His word. We can cultivate wisdom by reading the Bible, praying and sharing with other devout believers.

So let us call on God every day and ask Him to give us wisdom and understanding, that we may understand His will and show wise conduct in life. When we have the wisdom God gives, we will be better able to face life’s challenges, make right choices, and serve others with love and care.
ah: In Proverbs 2:6 we see that God gives wisdom; knowledge and understanding come out of His mouth. This reminds us that in daily life we can seek God’s wisdom and guidance through prayer and devotions. Here are some ways to help us put this truth into practice in life:
a: Pray often, asking God to give wisdom, to know God’s will and make wise decisions.
Learn humbly, listen attentively to the teaching of the wise, and absorb knowledge and life experience.
Think diligently, observe carefully the surroundings, people and things around you, and ponder the principles in them.
Humbly accept correction, draw lessons from mistakes, and do not be stuck in your own ways.
Deal with people and matters with wisdom, be considerate of others’ needs, and maintain harmonious relationships.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for giving wisdom, knowledge and understanding. Open our hearts so that we always seek and treasure the wisdom You give from Your mouth. Help us to learn humbly, listen attentively, think diligently and accept correction humbly, to deal with people and matters with wisdom, to please You and to glorify Your holy name. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you receive God’s guidance and blessing on your road of seeking wisdom. Amen.

t: God Gives a Wise and Understanding Heart
v: behold, I have done according to your word. Behold, I have given you a wise and understanding heart, so that there has been no one like you before you, and after you none will arise like you.
b: In this passage we see God promising King Solomon extraordinary wisdom and understanding. This reminds us that when we long for wisdom and understanding, God is also willing to give them to us.

A child at school met a very hard math problem and did not know how to solve it. He felt frustrated and helpless, but he decided to ask his teacher for help. Seeing his sincerity and effort, the teacher patiently explained the problem and taught him the related methods of solving it. In the end, the child successfully solved the problem.

This story tells us that when we meet difficulties, we should humbly seek wisdom and understanding from God. Like that child, we need to realize our own ignorance and helplessness and humbly accept God’s guidance and teaching. God is willing to give us wisdom and understanding so that we can face the challenges and difficulties of life.

Besides in study, we also need wisdom and understanding to handle relationships. Sometimes we may meet situations of conflict with others or difficulty in communicating. At such times we need keen wisdom to understand the other’s position and feelings, and to find a way to solve the problem. God’s wisdom can help us keep an attitude of harmony and love in relationships.

Let us keep pursuing God’s wisdom and understanding, and believe His promise. When we humbly seek wisdom from God, He will surely give us the wisdom and understanding we need, so that we can make wise and right choices in life.
ah: According to 1 Kings 3:12, God promises to give us wisdom and understanding, making us outstanding and unique among people. In daily life we can put this blessing into practice in the following ways:
a: Examine your conduct each day to make sure that your words and deeds accord with the teaching of the Bible, showing wisdom and understanding.
Pray to God, asking Him to give wisdom and understanding, to help us make right decisions when we face challenges and choices.
Study the Bible diligently and understand God’s word deeply, to guide our lives and conduct.
Learn to listen to and respect the opinions of others, get along with people with sincere love and a humble attitude, and show the wisdom God has given us.

Seek God’s will in everything, rely on His guidance and grace, and let our lives show the wisdom and understanding God has given. Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for promising us wisdom and understanding in today’s Soul Snack passage. Give us sensitive hearts and help us live out in daily life the wisdom You have given, so that we may be a blessing to those around us. Lord, help us understand Your will, seek Your guidance in everything, and let our lives show Your grace and love. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus, amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you live out the wisdom God has given you, so that you can face difficulties and find ways to solve problems. Amen.

v: The LORD’s law is perfect, restoring the soul. The LORD’s covenant is sure, making wise the simple.
b: This verse reminds us that God’s law is complete; it has the power to awaken our sleeping souls and make the simple wise. But the “simple” here does not refer only to those who lack knowledge and education, but to those who lack wisdom and discernment in life.

As a wise man once told me in a parable, there was a man named Mingde who often made unwise choices in life and frequently fell into trouble. He was lost in his own desires, chased by greed and vanity. He walked the busy streets of the city and yet still felt empty and powerless. Until one day he met a wise man, who said to Mingde, “Mingde, you need God’s law to guide your life. It is a guide to truth that can give you wisdom and direction.”

From that day Mingde began to read the Bible and learn God’s word. He found that God’s law not only told him what was right and wrong, but, more importantly, taught him how to discern the truth and changed his attitude and behavior. This gave his life new direction and purpose; he no longer pursued vanity and material satisfaction, but paid more attention to inner peace and the spreading of love.

Each of us also meets all kinds of difficulties and challenges in life, and sometimes we may feel lost and helpless. But when we rely on God’s law, as Mingde did, we can receive wisdom and guidance. God’s word is our guide; it teaches us how to make wise choices and how to bring love and hope to others.

So let us read the Bible every day and think deeply about God’s word. When we turn the truths of the Bible into action, our lives will be full of wisdom, hope and love. When we face challenges, we can rely on God’s word and find ways to solve problems. When we meet difficulties, we can trust God’s law and believe that He will lead us through.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you draw near to God’s word every day and find wisdom, hope and love through it. Amen.

t: You Will Make Me Know Wisdom
v: Behold, you desire truth in the inward parts. You teach me wisdom in the inmost place.
b: In this verse God tells us that what He desires is inward truthfulness. In every heart there is a hidden place that only God can see. In this hidden place we must show an attitude of sincerity and integrity. When we are honest with ourselves, sincere toward God and steadfast toward others, God will surely give us wisdom.

Imagine a farmer who has planted a vegetable garden. He must care not only for the appearance of the plants but also for their roots. Only a healthy root system can support strong plants. Just like our lives: outward success and greatness are only appearances, while inner sincerity and honesty are the foundation of our lives.

In our daily lives, are there masks of hypocrisy and pretense? Are we truly honest with ourselves, with God and with others? Let us be like the farmer, braving the wind and rain to care for our inner roots. Only when we learn to face our faults and mistakes honestly can God guide and bless us through His wisdom.

When we have the wisdom God gives, we can understand that the challenges and trials of life are only temporary, while God’s plan and purpose are eternal. Whenever we face difficulty, remember that God’s wisdom is our compass, leading us through the hard times.
ah: Psalm 51:6 says that what pleases God is inward truthfulness, and that He gives us wisdom in our hidden part. Here are a few concrete ways to put this passage into practice in daily life:
a: Keep Honest and Sincere
Whether interacting with others or thinking alone, stay honest and sincere. Do not hide your true thoughts and feelings, and build genuine relationships with God and others.
Meditation and Prayer
Regularly spend time with God, meditating on the Bible, praying and listening for His guidance. Through such devotional habits you will find it easier to hear God’s wisdom and leading.
Seek Good Counsel
If you have difficulties or doubts, do not bear them alone, but seek counsel from good Christian friends or a pastor. Share what troubles your heart, and receive their advice and blessing.
Practice Love and Forgiveness

In daily life, treat people with forgiveness and love, showing the people around you God’s love and forgiveness. This not only shows your honesty within, but also lets you receive more of God’s wisdom.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for giving us wisdom and strength to practice honesty and sincerity in our daily lives. May we show Your love and wisdom in all our words and deeds, and lead us into a deeper relationship with You. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus, amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you be guided by wisdom on your journey of seeking truth and honesty. May you be full of faith, hope and love, and understand the meaning of God giving wisdom in our hidden parts. Amen.

t: Blessed Is the One Who Finds Wisdom
v: Happy is the man who finds wisdom, the man who gets understanding.
b: In life we often meet many difficulties and challenges. Sometimes we may feel hesitant and not know how to make the right decision. Yet when we seek and gain wisdom, we can stay calm in the face of difficulty and make wise choices.

A young farmer got up early every morning and worked hard. He planted all kinds of crops and watched them gradually grow. But one day a great storm struck and destroyed all the crops he had so painstakingly raised. The farmer was very sad and discouraged, not knowing how to start again.

Soon afterward a wise elder from the village came to visit the farmer and said, “Farmer, you have been ravaged by the storm, but you still have the most precious thing, and that is wisdom. Wisdom is like a key; it can help you open a new door and find new opportunities and hope.”
This story tells us that when we have wisdom, we can see hope in difficulty. Wisdom lets us see the many possibilities in life and find ways to solve problems.

Besides this story, the Bible has many examples that can inspire us to seek wisdom. For example, Solomon, king of Israel, became a wise and discerning king because he sought wisdom. Wisdom is also a gift from God, and when we humbly ask God for wisdom, He will surely give us more wisdom and understanding.

Dear family, when you face life’s difficulties, remember to seek wisdom. It is not merely an accumulation of knowledge, but an ability that guides us to make right decisions. When we have wisdom, we can see that the difficulty before us is only temporary, and believe that God will lead us through hardship and bring us a better future.
a: Learn to Seek Wisdom
To gain wisdom and understanding, first have a heart willing to learn and seek. Reading the Bible, praying and sharing with fellow believers every day are all good ways to grow in wisdom.
Keep Company with Wisdom
Keeping company with wisdom is like making friends with the wise. Look for wise sayings in the Bible, keep them in mind, and let them guide the principles of your life.
Practice Wisdom
Wisdom is not just knowledge; it needs to be practiced. In daily life, look at things with the eyes of wisdom, think calmly when you meet a problem, and try to find the wisest solution.
Walk with Wisdom

Walking with wisdom not only improves the quality of your own life but can also be shared with the brothers and sisters around you, encouraging and building one another up and growing together on the road of faith.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for giving us the ability of wisdom and understanding, so that we can put this gift into practice in daily life. May we always love wisdom, and may the light of wisdom illuminate our path, so that we become people who please You. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you receive abundant blessing on your road of pursuing wisdom. May you look at life’s challenges with the eyes of wisdom, and find hope and courage in difficulty. Amen.
